This can be used for\\\\nsimulating multiple turns in a conversation in a way that matches real-world\\\\nuser behavior.\\\\n\\\\nYou can use either synthetic data or a custom dataset.\\\\nThis tutorial will guide you through setting up a model server and running a\\\\nprofiling session with simulated conversations or a predefined dataset.\\\\n\\\\n## Table of Contents\\\\n\\\\n- [Start a Chat Model Server](#start-a-chat-model-server)\\\\n- [Approach 1: Benchmark with Synthetic Data](#approach-1-benchmark-with-synthetic-data)\\\\n- [Approach 2: Benchmark with a Custom Dataset](#approach-2-benchmark-with-a-custom-dataset)\\\\n- [Review the Output](#review-the-output)\\\\n\\\\n## Start a Chat Model Server\\\\n\\\\nFirst, launch a vLLM server with an chat endpoint:\\\\n\\\\n```bash\\\\ndocker run -it --net=host --rm --gpus=all \\\\\\\\\\\\n  vllm/vllm-openai:latest \\\\\\\\\\\\n  --model TinyLlama/TinyLlama-1.1B-Chat-v1.0 \\\\\\\\\\\\n  --dtype float16 \\\\\\\\\\\\n  --max-model-len 1024\\\\n```\\\\n\\\\n## Approach 1: Benchmark with Synthetic Data\\\\n\\\\nUse synthetic data to simulate multiple chat sessions with controlled token\\\\ninput and response lengths.\\\\n\\\\n```bash\\\\ngenai-perf profile \\\\\\\\\\\\n  -m TinyLlama/TinyLlama-1.1B-Chat-v1.0 \\\\\\\\\\\\n  --endpoint-type chat \\\\\\\\\\\\n  --num-sessions 10 \\\\\\\\\\\\n  --session-concurrency 5 \\\\\\\\\\\\n  --session-turns-mean 2 \\\\\\\\\\\\n  --session-turns-stddev 0 \\\\\\\\\\\\n  --session-turn-delay-mean 1000 \\\\\\\\\\\\n  --session-turn-delay-stddev 5 \\\\\\\\\\\\n  --synthetic-input-tokens-mean 50 \\\\\\\\\\\\n  --output-tokens-mean 50 \\\\\\\\\\\\n  --num-prefix-prompts 3 \\\\\\\\\\\\n  --prefix-prompt-length 15\\\\n```\\\\n\\\\n### Understand Key Arguments\\\\n\\\\n#### Required Arguments\\\\n- `--num-sessions 10`: Simulates 10 independent chat sessions.\\\\n- `--session-concurrency 5`: Enables session mode and runs up to 5 sessions in\\\\nparallel.\\\\n\\\\n#### Optional Arguments\\\\n- `--session-turns-mean 2`: Each session has an average of 2 turns.\\\\n- `--session-turn-delay-mean 1000`: Introduces a 1-second delay between user\\\\nturns (simulating real-world interaction).\\\\n- `--synthetic-input-tokens-mean 50`: Each user input averages 50 tokens.\\\\n- `--output-tokens-mean 50`: Each model response averages 50 tokens.\\\\n- `--num-prefix-prompts 3`: Uses a pool of 3 system prompts for the first\\\\nturn in each session.\\\\n- `--prefix-prompt-length 15`: Each prefix prompt contains 15 tokens.\\\\n\\\\n---\\\\n\\\\n## Approach 2: Benchmark with a Custom Dataset\\\\n\\\\nIf you prefer to benchmark using a predefined dataset, create a JSONL input file\\\\nwith the dataset.\\\\n\\\\n### Example Input File\\\\n\\\\n```bash\\\\necho '{\\\\\\\"session_id\\\\\\\": \\\\\\\"f81d4fae-7dec-11d0-a765-00a0c91e6bf6\\\\\\\", \\\\\\\"delay\\\\\\\": 1000, \\\\\\\"input_length\\\\\\\": 50, \\\\\\\"output_length\\\\\\\": 10}\\\\n{\\\\\\\"session_id\\\\\\\": \\\\\\\"f81d4fae-7dec-11d0-a765-00a0c91e6bf6\\\\\\\", \\\\\\\"delay\\\\\\\": 2000, \\\\\\\"input_length\\\\\\\": 50, \\\\\\\"output_length\\\\\\\": 10}\\\\n{\\\\\\\"session_id\\\\\\\": \\\\\\\"f81d4fae-7dec-11d0-a765-00a0c91e6bf6\\\\\\\", \\\\\\\"input_length\\\\\\\": 100, \\\\\\\"output_length\\\\\\\": 10}\\\\n{\\\\\\\"session_id\\\\\\\": \\\\\\\"113059749145936325402354257176981405696\\\\\\\", \\\\\\\"delay\\\\\\\": 1000, \\\\\\\"input_length\\\\\\\": 25, \\\\\\\"output_length\\\\\\\": 20}\\\\n{\\\\\\\"session_id\\\\\\\": \\\\\\\"113059749145936325402354257176981405696\\\\\\\", \\\\\\\"input_length\\\\\\\": 20, \\\\\\\"output_length\\\\\\\": 20}' > inputs.jsonl\\\\n```\\\\n\\\\n### Understand Key Arguments\\\\n\\\\nMost of the arguments are the same as the synthetic data approach.\\\\nThe new ones are detailed below.\\\\n\\\\n#### Optional Arguments\\\\n- `--session-delay-ratio`: Modifies the delays in the payload file. The delays\\\\nare multiplied by this ratio. This makes it easier to tune delays to represent\\\\ndifferent scenarios.\\\\n\\\\n### Understand Key Fields\\\\n\\\\n#### Required Fields\\\\n- `delay`: Sets the delay in milliseconds to wait after receiving a response\\\\nbefore sending the next request. This field is required except for the\\\\nlast turn in a session.\\\\n\\\\n#### Optional Fields\\\\n- `input_length`: Sets the token length of the input for this request.\\\\n- `output_length`: Sets the token length of the output for this request.\\\\n- `text`: Provides the prompt text, if you prefer to bring your own rather\\\\nthan have it be synthetically generated.\\\\n\\\\n### Run GenAI-Perf \\\"074479dbeb369205ccc8800450c647893b4901c247e0e4ee7f321f05254e9305\\\", \\\"reading_scope\\\": \\\"full\\\", \\\"category\\\": \\\"source_original\\\", \\\"content\\\": \\\"# Overview {#mainpage}\\\\n\\\\n## Introduction\\\\n\\\\n* The LoadGen is a *reusable* module that *efficiently* and *fairly* measures\\\\n  the performance of inference systems.\\\\n* It generates traffic for scenarios as formulated by a diverse set of experts\\\\n  in the [MLCommons working group](https://mlcommons.org/).\\\\n* The scenarios emulate the workloads seen in mobile devices,\\\\n  autonomous vehicles, robotics, and cloud-based setups.\\\\n* Although the LoadGen is not model or dataset aware, its strength is in its\\\\n  reusability with logic that is.\\\\n\\\\n## Integration Example and Flow\\\\nThe following is an diagram of how the LoadGen can be integrated into an\\\\ninference system, resembling how some of the MLPerf reference models are\\\\nimplemented.\\\\n<div style=\\\\\\\"display:flex; flex-flow:row wrap; justify-content: space-evenly;\\\\\\\">\\\\n<img src=\\\\\\\"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mlcommons/inference/master/loadgen/loadgen_integration_diagram.svg\\\\\\\" width=\\\\\\\"500px\\\\\\\" style=\\\\\\\"padding: 20px\\\\\\\">\\\\n<ol style=\\\\\\\"padding: 20px\\\\\\\">\\\\n<li>Benchmark knows the model, dataset, and preprocessing.</li>\\\\n<li>Benchmark hands dataset sample IDs to LoadGen.</li>\\\\n<li>LoadGen starts generating queries of sample IDs.</li>\\\\n<li>Benchmark creates requests to backend.</li>\\\\n<li>Result is post processed and forwarded to LoadGen.</li>\\\\n<li>LoadGen outputs logs for analysis.<br>\\\\n</ol>\\\\n</div>\\\\n\\\\n## Useful Links\\\\n* [FAQ](README_FAQ.md)\\\\n* [LoadGen Build Instructions](README_BUILD.md)\\\\n* [LoadGen API](loadgen.h)\\\\n* [Test Settings](test_settings.h) -\\\\n  A good description of available scenarios, modes, and knobs.\\\\n* [MLPerf Inference Code](https://github.com/mlcommons/inference) -\\\\n  Includes source for the LoadGen and reference models that use the LoadGen.\\\\n* [MLPerf Inference Rules](https://github.com/mlcommons/inference_policies) -\\\\n  Any mismatch with this is a bug in the LoadGen.\\\\n\\\\n## Scope of the LoadGen's Responsibilities\\\\n\\\\n### In Scope\\\\n* **Provide a reusable** C++ library with python bindings.\\\\n* **Implement** the traffic patterns of the MLPerf Inference scenarios and\\\\n  modes.\\\\n* **Record** all traffic generated and received for later analysis and\\\\n  verification.\\\\n* **Summarize** the results and whether performance constraints were met.\\\\n* **Target high-performance** systems with efficient multi-thread friendly\\\\n  logging utilities.\\\\n* **Generate trust** via a shared, well-tested, and community-hardened\\\\n  code base.\\\\n\\\\n### Out of Scope\\\\nThe LoadGen is:\\\\n* **NOT** aware of the ML model it is running against.\\\\n* **NOT** aware of the data formats of the model's inputs and outputs.\\\\n* **NOT** aware of how to score the accuracy of a model's outputs.\\\\n* **NOT** aware of MLPerf rules regarding scenario-specific constraints.\\\\n\\\\nLimitting the scope of the LoadGen in this way keeps it reusable across\\\\ndifferent models and datasets without modification. Using composition and\\\\ndependency injection, the user can define their own model, datasets, and\\\\nmetrics.\\\\n\\\\nAdditionally, not hardcoding MLPerf-specific test constraints, like test\\\\nduration and performance targets, allows users to use the LoadGen unmodified\\\\nfor custom testing and continuous integration purposes.\\\\n\\\\n## Submission Considerations\\\\n\\\\n### Upstream all local modifications\\\\n* As a rule, no local modifications to the LoadGen's C++ library are allowed\\\\nfor submission.\\\\n* Please upstream early and often to keep the playing field level.\\\\n\\\\n### Choose your TestSettings carefully!\\\\n* Since the LoadGen is oblivious to the model, it can't enforce the MLPerf\\\\nrequirements for submission. *e.g.:* target percentiles and latencies.\\\\n* For verification, the values in TestSettings are logged.\\\\n* To help make sure your settings are spec compliant, use\\\\nTestSettings::FromConfig in conjunction with the relevant config file provided\\\\nwith the reference models.\\\\n\\\\n## Responsibilities of a LoadGen User\\\\n\\\\n### Implement the Interfaces\\\\n* Implement the SystemUnderTest and QuerySampleLibrary interfaces and pass\\\\n  them to the StartTest function.\\\\n* Call QuerySampleComplete for every sample received by\\\\n  SystemUnderTest::IssueQuery.\\\\n\\\\n### Assess Accuracy\\\\n* Process the *mlperf_log_accuracy.json* output by the LoadGen to determine\\\\n  the accuracy of your system.\\\\n* For the official models, Python scripts will be provided by the MLPerf model\\\\n  owners for you to do this automatically.\\\\n\\\\nFor templates of how to do the above in detail, refer to code for the demos,\\\\ntests, and reference models.\\\\n\\\\n\\\\n## LoadGen over the Network\\\\n\\\\nFor reference, on a high level a submission looks like this:\\\\n\\\\n<div align=\\\\\\\"center\\\\\\\" style=\\\\\\\"display:flex; flex-flow:row wrap; justify-content: space-evenly;\\\\\\\">\\\\n<img src=\\\\\\\"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mlcommons/inference/master/loadgen/diagram_submission.png\\\\\\\" width=\\\\\\\"300px\\\\\\\" style=\\\\\\\"padding: 20px\\\\\\\">\\\\n</div>\\\\n\\\\nThe LoadGen implementation is common to all submissions, while the QSL (“Query Sample Library”) and SUT (“System Under Test”) are implemented by submitters. QSL is responsible for loading the data and includes untimed preprocessing.\\\\n\\\\nA submission over the network introduces a new component “QDL” (query dispatch library) that is added to the system as presented in the following diagram:\\\\n\\\\n<div align=\\\\\\\"center\\\\\\\" style=\\\\\\\"display:flex; flex-flow:row wrap; justify-content: space-evenly;\\\\\\\">\\\\n<img src=\\\\\\\"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mlcommons/inference/master/loadgen/diagram_network_submission.png\\\\\\\" width=\\\\\\\"300px\\\\\\\" style=\\\\\\\"padding: 20px\\\\\\\">\\\\n</div>\\\\n\\\\nQDL is a proxy for a load-balancer, that dispatches queries to SUT over a physical network, receives the responses and passes them back to LoadGen.  It is implemented by the submitter. The interface of the QDL is the same as the API to SUT. \\\\n\\\\nIn scenarios using QDL, data may be compressed in QSL at the choice of the submitter in order to reduce network transmission time. Decompression is part of the timed processing in SUT. A set of approved standard compression schemes will be specified for each benchmark; additional compression schemes must be approved in advance by the Working Group.\\\\n\\\\nAll communication between LoadGen/QSL and SUT is via QDL, and all communication between QDL and SUT must pass over a physical network.\\\\n\\\\nQDL implements the protocol to transmit queries over the network and receive responses. It also implements decompression of any response returned by the SUT, where compression of responses is allowed. Performing any part of the timed preprocessing or inference in QDL is specifically disallowed. Currently no batching is allowed in QDL, although this may be revisited in future.\\\\n\\\\nThe MLperf over the Network will run in Server mode and Offline mode. All LoadGen modes are expected to work as is with insignificant changes. These include running the test in performance mode, accuracy mode, find peak performance mode and compliance mode. The same applies for power measurements.\\\\n\\\\n### QDL details\\\\nThe Query Dispatch Library is implemented by the submitter and interfaces with LoadGen using the same SUT API. All MLPerf Inference SUTs implement the `mlperf::SystemUnderTest` class which is defined in system_under_test.h. The QDL implements `mlperf::QueryDispatchLibrary` class which inherits the `mlperf::SystemUnderTest` class and has the same API and support all existing `mlperf::SystemUnderTest` methods. It has a separate header file query_dispatch_library.h. Using sut with `mlperf::SystemUnderTest` class in LoadGen StartTest is natively upcasting `mlperf::QueryDispatchLibrary` class.\\\\n\\\\n#### QDL Query issue and response over the network\\\\n\\\\nThe QDL gets the queries from the LoadGen through \\\\n```CPP\\\\nvoid IssueQuery(const std::vector<QuerySample>& samples)\\\\n```\\\\n\\\\nThe QDL dispatches the queries to the SUT over the physical media. The exact method and implementation for it are submitter specific and would not be specified at MLCommons. Submitter implementation includes all methods required to serialize the query, load balance, drive it to the Operating system and network interface card and send to the SUT.\\\\n\\\\nThe QDL receives the query responses over the network from the SUT. The exact method and implementation for it are submitter specific and would not be specified at MLCommons. The submitter implementation includes all methods required to receive the network data from the Network Interface card, go through the Operating system, deserialize the query response, and provide it back to the LoadGen through query completion by:\\\\n\\\\n```CPP\\\\nstruct QuerySampleResponse {\\\\n  ResponseId id;\\\\n  uintptr_t data;\\\\n  size_t size;\\\\n};\\\\nvoid QuerySamplesComplete(QuerySampleResponse* responses, \\\\n                          size_t response_count);\\\\n\\\\n```\\\\n\\\\n#### QDL Additional Methods\\\\n\\\\nIn addition to that the QDL needs to implement the following methods that are provided by the SUT interface to the LoadGen:\\\\n```CPP\\\\nconst std::string& Name();\\\\n```\\\\nThe `Name` function returns a known string for over the Network SUTs to identify it as over the network benchmark.\\\\n```CPP\\\\nvoid FlushQueries();\\\\n```\\\\n\\\\nIt is not specified here how the QDL would query and configure the SUT to execute the above methods. The QDL responds to the LoadGen after receiving its own response from the SUT.\\\\n\\\\n### Example\\\\n\\\\nRefer to [LON demo](demos/lon) for a reference example illustrating usage of Loadgen over the network.\\\\n\\\\n## Find Peak Performance Mode\\\\n\\\\nThe Find Peak Performance mode can be used to find the optimal queries per second (QPS) for the server scenario.\\\\n\\\\n### Setup\\\\n\\\\nYou can setup loadgen to run this mode by setting the `mode` variable in the `test_settings` used to run the test. Using the Python API:\\\\n\\\\n```python\\\\nsettings = mlperf_loadgen.TestSettings()\\\\nsettings.server_target_qps = 100\\\\nsettings.scenario = mlperf_loadgen.TestScenario.Server\\\\nsettings.mode = mlperf_loadgen.TestMode.FindPeakPerformance\\\\n...\\\\n\\\\nmlperf_loadgen.StartTest(sut, qsl, settings)\\\\n```\\\\n\\\\nUsing the C/C++ API:\\\\n```CPP\\\\nmlperf::TestSettings settings;\\\\nsetting.server_target_qps = 100;\\\\nsettings.scenario = mlperf::TestScenario::Server;\\\\nsettings.mode = mlperf::TestMode::FindPeakPerformance;\\\\nmlperf::LogSettings log_settings;\\\\n/*\\\\nConstruct QSL and SUT\\\\n*/\\\\nmlperf::StartTest(&sut, &qsl, settings, log_settings);\\\\n```\\\\n\\\\n**Note:** Make sure you are setting the TestScenario to server and you are providing an initial target QPS.\\\\n\\\\n### Description\\\\n\\\\nThe Find Peak Performance mode works by finding a lower and upper boundary for the optimal QPS. Then performing a binary search between the lower and upper bound to find the optimal QPS.\\\\n\\\\n#### Finding lower and upper boundary\\\\n\\\\nLoadGen begins by running performance mode at the specified target QPS. If the test passes, this value is used as the lower bound; otherwise, an error is raised. The algorithm then guesses the upper bound as twice the target QPS. \\\\n\\\\nThen LoadGen will run performance mode using the upper bound guess. If the test is successful, both the lower bound and upper bound will be doubled. This repeats until the upper bound guess fails the test.\\\\n\\\\n```\\\\n[initial_target_qps, 2*initial_target_qps] -> [2*initial_target_qps, 4*initial_target_qps] -> [4*initial_target_qps, 8*initial_target_qps]...\\\\n```\\\\n\\\\nFinally, the final lower bound and upper bound are set to their current values. This process assures that the lower bound passes the performance mode, but the upper bound doesn’t.\\\\n\\\\n#### Binary Search\\\\n\\\\nOnce the lower and upper bounds are set, binary search can be performed over the range `[lower, upper]`` to find the optimal QPS. If a given QPS fails in performance mode, the optimal value lies below it; if it passes, the optimal is higher.\\\\n\\\", \\\"excerpt_ranges\\\": [[0, 11382]], \\\"range_unit\\\": \\\"zero-based half-open characters in extracted text\\\", \\\"extracted_characters\\\": 11382, \\\"selected_characters\\\": 11382, \\\"extraction\\\": \\\"UTF-8 text\\\", \\\"selection_reason\\\": \\\"full extracted text fits allocation\\\"}, {\\\"path\\\": \\\"references/S-ASGI/fulltext.txt\\\", \\\"sha256\\\": \\\"ba273c91f3e7b8c32f863e8b57145798c3b5c9275073f758a41e1cb0a6f5bee3\\\", \\\"reading_scope\\\": \\\"full\\\", \\\"category\\\": \\\"source_original\\\", \\\"content\\\": \\\"\\\\n===== specs/www.rst =====\\\\n====================================\\\\nHTTP & WebSocket ASGI Message Format\\\\n====================================\\\\n\\\\n**Version**: 2.5 (2024-06-05)\\\\n\\\\nThe HTTP+WebSocket ASGI sub-specification outlines how to transport HTTP/1.1,\\\\nHTTP/2 and WebSocket connections within ASGI.\\\\n\\\\nIt is deliberately intended and designed to be a superset of the WSGI format\\\\nand specifies how to translate between the two for the set of requests that\\\\nare able to be handled by WSGI.\\\\n\\\\n\\\\nSpec Versions\\\\n-------------\\\\n\\\\nThis spec has had the following versions:\\\\n\\\\n* ``2.0``: The first version of the spec, released with ASGI 2.0\\\\n* ``2.1``: Added the ``headers`` key to the WebSocket Accept response\\\\n* ``2.2``: Allow ``None`` in the second item of ``server`` scope value.\\\\n* ``2.3``: Added the ``reason`` key to the WebSocket close event.\\\\n* ``2.4``: Calling ``send()`` on a closed connection should raise an error\\\\n* ``2.5``: Added the ``reason`` key to the WebSocket disconnect event.\\\\n\\\\nSpec versions let you understand what the server you are using understands. If\\\\na server tells you it only supports version ``2.0`` of this spec, then\\\\nsending ``headers`` with a WebSocket Accept message is an error, for example.\\\\n\\\\nThey are separate from the HTTP version or the ASGI version.\\\\n\\\\n\\\\nHTTP\\\\n----\\\\n\\\\nThe HTTP format covers HTTP/1.0, HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2, as the changes in\\\\nHTTP/2 are largely on the transport level. A protocol server should give\\\\ndifferent scopes to different requests on the same HTTP/2 connection, and\\\\ncorrectly multiplex the responses back to the same stream in which they came.\\\\nThe HTTP version is available as a string in the scope.\\\\n\\\\nMultiple header fields with the same name are complex in HTTP. RFC 7230\\\\nstates that for any header field that can appear multiple times, it is exactly\\\\nequivalent to sending that header field only once with all the values joined by\\\\ncommas.\\\\n\\\\nHowever, for HTTP cookies (``Cookie`` and ``Set-Cookie``) the allowed behaviour\\\\ndoes not follow the above rule, and also varies slightly based on the HTTP\\\\nprotocol version:\\\\n\\\\n* For the ``Set-Cookie`` header in HTTP/1.0, HTTP/1.1 and HTTP2.0, it may appear\\\\n  repeatedly, but cannot be concatenated by commas (or anything else) into a\\\\n  single header field.\\\\n\\\\n* For the ``Cookie`` header, in HTTP/1.0 and HTTP/1.1, RFC 7230 and RFC 6265\\\\n  make it clear that the ``Cookie`` header must only be sent once by a\\\\n  user-agent, and must be concatenated into a single octet string using the\\\\n  two-octet delimiter of 0x3b, 0x20 (the ASCII string \\\\\\\"; \\\\\\\"). However in HTTP/2,\\\\n  RFC 9113 states that ``Cookie`` headers MAY appear repeatedly, OR be\\\\n  concatenated using the two-octet delimiter of 0x3b, 0x20\\\\n  (the ASCII string \\\\\\\"; \\\\\\\").\\\\n\\\\nThe ASGI design decision is to transport both request and response headers as\\\\nlists of 2-element ``[name, value]`` lists and preserve headers exactly as they\\\\nwere provided.\\\\n\\\\nFor ASGI applications that support HTTP/2, care should be taken to handle the\\\\nspecial case for ``Cookie`` noted above.\\\\n\\\\nThe HTTP protocol should be signified to ASGI applications with a ``type``\\\\nvalue of ``http``.\\\\n\\\\n\\\\nHTTP Connection Scope\\\\n'''''''''''''''''''''\\\\n\\\\nHTTP connections have a single-request *connection scope* - that is, your\\\\napplication will be called at the start of the request, and will last until\\\\nthe end of that specific request, even if the underlying socket is still open\\\\nand serving multiple requests.\\\\n\\\\nIf you hold a response open for long-polling or similar, the *connection scope*\\\\nwill persist until the response closes from either the client or server side.\\\\n\\\\nThe *connection scope* information passed in ``scope`` contains:\\\\n\\\\n* ``type`` (*Unicode string*) -- ``\\\\\\\"http\\\\\\\"``.\\\\n\\\\n* ``asgi[\\\\\\\"version\\\\\\\"]`` (*Unicode string*) -- Version of the ASGI spec.\\\\n\\\\n* ``asgi[\\\\\\\"spec_version\\\\\\\"]`` (*Unicode string*) -- Version of the ASGI\\\\n  HTTP spec this server understands; for example: ``\\\\\\\"2.0\\\\\\\"``, ``\\\\\\\"2.1\\\\\\\"``, ``\\\\\\\"2.2\\\\\\\"``,\\\\n  etc. Optional; if missing assume ``\\\\\\\"2.0\\\\\\\"``.\\\\n\\\\n* ``http_version`` (*Unicode string*) -- One of ``\\\\\\\"1.0\\\\\\\"``, ``\\\\\\\"1.1\\\\\\\"`` or ``\\\\\\\"2\\\\\\\"``.\\\\n\\\\n* ``method`` (*Unicode string*) -- The HTTP method name, uppercased.\\\\n\\\\n* ``scheme`` (*Unicode string*) -- URL scheme portion (likely ``\\\\\\\"http\\\\\\\"`` or\\\\n  ``\\\\\\\"https\\\\\\\"``). Optional (but must not be empty); default is ``\\\\\\\"http\\\\\\\"``.\\\\n\\\\n* ``path`` (*Unicode string*) -- HTTP request target excluding any query\\\\n  string, with percent-encoded sequences and UTF-8 byte sequences\\\\n  decoded into characters.\\\\n\\\\n* ``raw_path`` (*byte string*) -- The original HTTP path component,\\\\n  excluding any query string, unmodified from the bytes that were\\\\n  received by the web server. Some web server implementations may\\\\n  be unable to provide this. Optional; if missing defaults to ``None``.\\\\n\\\\n* ``query_string`` (*byte string*) -- URL portion after the ``?``,\\\\n  percent-encoded.\\\\n\\\\n* ``root_path`` (*Unicode string*) -- The root path this application\\\\n  is mounted at; same as ``SCRIPT_NAME`` in WSGI. Optional; if missing\\\\n  defaults to ``\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"``.\\\\n\\\\n* ``headers`` (*Iterable[[byte string, byte string]]*) -- An iterable of\\\\n  ``[name, value]`` two-item iterables, where ``name`` is the header name, and\\\\n  ``value`` is the header value. Order of header values must be preserved from\\\\n  the original HTTP request; order of header names is not important. Duplicates\\\\n  are possible and must be preserved in the message as received. Header names\\\\n  should be lowercased, but it is not required; servers should preserve header case\\\\n  on a best-effort basis. Pseudo headers (present in HTTP/2 and HTTP/3) must be\\\\n  removed; if ``:authority`` is present its value must be added to the start of\\\\n  the iterable with ``host`` as the header name or replace any existing host\\\\n  header already present.\\\\n\\\\n* ``client`` (*Iterable[Unicode string, int]*) -- A two-item iterable\\\\n  of ``[host, port]``, where ``host`` is the remote host's IPv4 or\\\\n  IPv6 address, and ``port`` is the remote port as an\\\\n  integer. Optional; if missing defaults to ``None``.\\\\n\\\\n* ``server`` (*Iterable[Unicode string, Optional[int]]*) -- Either a\\\\n  two-item iterable of ``[host, port]``, where ``host`` is the\\\\n  listening address for this server, and ``port`` is the integer\\\\n  listening port, or ``[path, None]`` where ``path`` is that of the\\\\n  unix socket. Optional; if missing defaults to ``None``.\\\\n\\\\n* ``state`` Optional(*dict[Unicode string, Any]*) -- A copy of the\\\\n  namespace passed into the lifespan corresponding to this request. (See :doc:`lifespan`).\\\\n  Optional; if missing the server does not support this feature.\\\\n\\\\nServers are responsible for handling inbound and outbound chunked transfer\\\\nencodings. A request with a ``chunked`` encoded body should be automatically\\\\nde-chunked by the server and presented to the application as plain body bytes;\\\\na response that is given to the server with no ``Content-Length`` may be chunked\\\\nas the server sees fit.\\\\n\\\\n\\\\nRequest - ``receive`` event\\\\n'''''''''''''''''''''''''''\\\\n\\\\nSent to the application to indicate an incoming request. Most of the request\\\\ninformation is in the connection ``scope``; the body message serves as a way to\\\\nstream large incoming HTTP bodies in chunks, and as a trigger to actually run\\\\nrequest code (as you should not trigger on a connection opening alone).\\\\n\\\\nNote that if the request is being sent using ``Transfer-Encoding: chunked``,\\\\nthe server is responsible for handling this encoding. The ``http.request``\\\\nmessages should contain just the decoded contents of each chunk.\\\\n\\\\nKeys:\\\\n\\\\n* ``type`` (*Unicode string*) -- ``\\\\\\\"http.request\\\\\\\"``.\\\\n\\\\n* ``body`` (*byte string*) -- Body of the request. Optional; if\\\\n  missing defaults to ``b\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"``. If ``more_body`` is set, treat as start\\\\n  of body and concatenate on further chunks.\\\\n\\\\n* ``more_body`` (*bool*) -- Signifies if there is additional content\\\\n  to come (as part of a Request message). If ``True``, the consuming\\\\n  application should wait until it gets a chunk with this set to\\\\n  ``False``. If ``False``, the request is complete and should be\\\\n  processed. Optional; if missing defaults to ``False``.\\\\n\\\\n\\\\nResponse Start - ``send`` event\\\\n'''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''\\\\n\\\\nSent by the application to start sending a response to the client. Needs to be\\\\nfollowed by at least one response content message.\\\\n\\\\nProtocol servers *need not* flush the data generated by this event to the\\\\nsend buffer until the first *Response Body* event is processed.\\\\nThis may give them more leeway to replace the response with an error response\\\\nin case internal errors occur while handling the request.\\\\n\\\\nYou may send a ``Transfer-Encoding`` header in this message, but the server\\\\nmust ignore it. Servers handle ``Transfer-Encoding`` themselves, and may opt\\\\nto use ``Transfer-Encoding: chunked`` if the application presents a response\\\\nthat has no ``Content-Length`` set.\\\\n\\\\nNote that this is not the same as ``Content-Encoding``, which the application\\\\nstill controls, and which is the appropriate place to set ``gzip`` or other\\\\ncompression flags.\\\\n\\\\nKeys:\\\\n\\\\n* ``type`` (*Unicode string*) -- ``\\\\\\\"http.response.start\\\\\\\"``.\\\\n\\\\n* ``status`` (*int*) -- HTTP status code.\\\\n\\\\n* ``headers`` (*Iterable[[byte string, byte string]]*) -- An iterable\\\\n  of ``[name, value]`` two-item iterables, where ``name`` is the\\\\n  header name, and ``value`` is the header value. Order must be\\\\n  preserved in the HTTP response.  Header names must be\\\\n  lowercased. Optional; if missing defaults to an empty list. Pseudo\\\\n  headers (present in HTTP/2 and HTTP/3) must not be present.\\\\n\\\\n* ``trailers`` (*bool*) -- Signifies if the application will send\\\\n  trailers. If ``True``, the server must wait until it receives a\\\\n  ``\\\\\\\"http.response.trailers\\\\\\\"`` message after the *Response Body* event.\\\\n  Optional; if missing defaults to ``False``.\\\\n\\\\n\\\\nResponse Body - ``send`` event\\\\n''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''\\\\n\\\\nContinues sending a response to the client. Protocol servers must\\\\nflush any data passed to them into the send buffer before returning from a\\\\nsend call. If ``more_body`` is set to ``False``, and the server is not\\\\nexpecting *Response Trailers* this will complete the response.\\\\n\\\\nKeys:\\\\n\\\\n* ``type`` (*Unicode string*) -- ``\\\\\\\"http.response.body\\\\\\\"``.\\\\n\\\\n* ``body`` (*byte string*) -- HTTP body content. Concatenated onto any\\\\n  previous ``body`` values sent in this connection scope. Optional; if\\\\n  missing defaults to ``b\\\\\\\"\\\\\\\"``.\\\\n\\\\n* ``more_body`` (*bool*) -- Signifies if there is additional content\\\\n  to come (as part of a *Response Body* message). If ``False``, and the\\\\n  server is not expecting *Response Trailers* response will be taken as\\\\n  complete and closed, and any further messages on the channel will be\\\\n  ignored. Optional; if missing defaults to ``False``.\\\\n\\\\n\\\\nDisconnected Client - ``send`` exception\\\\n''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''\\\\n\\\\nIf ``send()`` is called on a closed connection the server should raise\\\\na server-specific subclass of ``OSError``. This is not guaranteed, however,\\\\nespecially on older ASGI server implementations (it was introduced in spec\\\\nversion 2.4).\\\\n\\\\nApplications may catch this exception and do cleanup work before\\\\nre-raising it or returning with no exception.\\\\n\\\\nServers must be prepared to catch this exception if they raised it and\\\\nshould not log it as an error in their server logs.\\\\n\\\\n\\\\nDisconnect - ``receive`` event\\\\n''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''\\\\n\\\\nSent to the application if receive is called after a response has been\\\\nsent or after the HTTP connection has been closed. This is mainly useful\\\\nfor long-polling, where you may want to trigger cleanup code if the\\\\nconnection closes early.\\\\n\\\\nOnce you have received this event, you should expect future calls to ``send()``\\\\nto raise an exception, as described above. However, if you have highly\\\\nconcurrent code, you may find calls to ``send()`` erroring slightly before you\\\\nreceive this event.\\\\n\\\\nKeys:\\\\n\\\\n* ``type`` (*Unicode string*) -- ``\\\\\\\"http.disconnect\\\\\\\"``.\\\\n\\\\n\\\\nWebSocket\\\\n---------\\\\n\\\\nWebSockets share some HTTP details - they have a path and headers - but also\\\\nhave more state. Again, most of that state is in the ``scope``, which will live\\\\nas long as the socket does.\\\\n\\\\nWebSocket protocol servers should handle PING/PONG messages themselves, and\\\\nsend PING messages as necessary to ensure the connection is alive.\\\\n\\\\nWebSocket protocol servers should handle message fragmentation themselves,\\\\nand deliver complete messages to the application.\\\\n\\\\nThe WebSocket protocol should be signified to ASGI applications with\\\\na ``type`` value of ``websocket``.\\\\n\\\\n\\\\nWebsocket Connection Scope\\\\n''''''''''''''''''''''''''\\\\n\\\\nWebSocket connections' scope lives as long as the socket itself - if the\\\\napplication dies the socket should be closed, and vice-versa.\\\\n\\\\nThe *connection scope* information passed in ``scope`` contains initial connection\\\\nmetadata (mostly from the HTTP request line and headers):\\\\n\\\\n* ``type`` (*Unicode string*) -- ``\\\\\\\"websocket\\\\\\\"``.\\\\n\\\\n* ``asgi[\\\\\\\"version\\\\\\\"]`` (*Unicode string*) -- The version of the ASGI spec.\\\\n\\\\n* ``asgi[\\\\\\\"spec_version\\\\\\\"]`` (*Unicode string*) -- Version of the ASGI\\\\n  HTTP spec this server understands; one of ``\\\\\\\"2.0\\\\\\\"``, ``\\\\\\\"2.1\\\\\\\"``, ``\\\\\\\"2.2\\\\\\\"`` or\\\\n  ``\\\\\\\"2.3\\\\\\\"``. Optional; if missing assume ``\\\\\\\"2.0\\\\\\\"``.\\\\n\\\\n* ``http_version`` (*Unicode string*) -- One of ``\\\\\\\"1.1\\\\\\\"`` or\\\\n  ``\\\\\\\"2\\\\\\\"``. Optional; if missing default is ``\\\\\\\"1.1\\\\\\\"``.\\\\n\\\\n* ``scheme`` (*Unicode string*) -- URL scheme portion (likely ``\\\\\\\"ws\\\\\\\"`` or\\\\n  ``\\\\\\\"wss\\\\\\\"``). Optional (but must not be empty); default is ``\\\\\\\"ws\\\\\\\"``.\\\\n\\\\n* ``path`` (*Unicode string*) -- HTTP request target excluding any query\\\\n  string, with percent-encoded sequences and UTF-8 byte sequences\\\\n  decoded into characters.\\\\n\\\\n* ``raw_path`` (*byte string*) -- The original HTTP path component,\\\\n  excluding any query string, unmodified from the bytes that were\\\\n  received by the web server. Some web server implementations may\\\\n  be unable to provide this. Optional; if missing defaults to ``None``.\\\\n\\\\n* ``query_string`` (*byte string*) -- URL portion after the\\\\n  ``?``. Optional; if missing or ``None`` default is empty string.\\\\n\\\\n* ``root_path`` (*Unicode string*) -- The root path this application is\\\\n  mounted at; same as ``SCRIPT_NAME`` in WSGI. Optional; if missing\\\\n  defaults to empty string.\\\\n\\\\n* ``headers`` (*Iterable[[byte string, byte string]]*) -- An iterable of\\\\n  ``[name, value]`` two-item iterables, where ``name`` is the header name and\\\\n  ``value`` is the header value. Order should be preserved from the original\\\\n  HTTP request; duplicates are possible and must be preserved in the message\\\\n  as received. Header names should be lowercased, but it is not required;\\\\n  servers should preserve header case on a best-effort basis.\\\\n  Pseudo headers (present in HTTP/2 and HTTP/3) must be removed;\\\\n  if ``:authority`` is present its value must be added to the\\\\n  start of the iterable with ``host`` as the header name\\\\n  or replace any existing host header already present.\\\\n\\\\n* ``client`` (*Iterable[Unicode string, int]*) -- A two-item iterable\\\\n  of ``[host, port]``, where ``host`` is the remote host's IPv4 or\\\\n  IPv6 address, and ``port`` is the remote port. Optional; if missing\\\\n  defaults to ``None``.\\\\n\\\\n* ``server`` (*Iterable[Unicode string, Optional[int]]*) -- Either a\\\\n  two-item iterable of ``[host, port]``, where ``host`` is the\\\\n  listening address for this server, and ``port`` is the integer\\\\n  listening port, or ``[path, None]`` where ``path`` is that of the\\\\n  unix socket. Optional; if missing defaults to ``None``.\\\\n\\\\n* ``subprotocols`` (*Iterable[Unicode string]*) -- Subprotocols the\\\\n  client advertised. Optional; if missing defaults to empty list.\\\\n\\\\n* ``state`` Optional(*dict[Unicode string, Any]*) -- A copy of the\\\\n  namespace passed into the lifespan corresponding to this request. (See :doc:`lifespan`).\\\\n  Optional; if missing the server does not support this feature.\\\\n\\\\n\\\\nConnect - ``receive`` event\\\\n'''''''''''''''''''''''''''\\\\n\\\\nSent to the application when the client initially opens a connection and is about\\\\nto finish the WebSocket handshake.\\\\n\\\\nThis message must be responded to with either an *Accept* message\\\\nor a *Close* message before the socket will pass ``websocket.receive``\\\\nmessages. The protocol server must send this message\\\\nduring the handshake phase of the WebSocket and not complete the handshake\\\\nuntil it gets a reply, returning HTTP status code ``403`` if the connection is\\\\ndenied.\\\\n\\\\nKeys:\\\\n\\\\n* ``type`` (*Unicode string*) -- ``\\\\\\\"websocket.connect\\\\\\\"``.\\\\n\\\\n\\\\nAccept - ``send`` event\\\\n'''''''''''''''''''''''\\\\n\\\\nSent by the application when it wishes to accept an incoming connection.\\\\n\\\\n* ``type`` (*Unicode string*) -- ``\\\\\\\"websocket.accept\\\\\\\"``.\\\\n\\\\n* ``subprotocol`` (*Unicode string*) -- The subprotocol the server\\\\n  wishes to accept. Optional; if missing defaults to ``None``.\\\\n\\\\n* ``headers`` (*Iterable[[byte string, byte string]]*) -- An iterable\\\\n  of ``[name, value]`` two-item iterables, where ``name`` is the\\\\n  header name, and ``value`` is the header value. Order must be\\\\n  preserved in the HTTP response.  Header names must be\\\\n  lowercased. Must not include a header named\\\\n  ``sec-websocket-protocol``; use the ``subprotocol`` key\\\\n  instead. Optional; if missing defaults to an empty list. *Added in\\\\n  spec version 2.1*. Pseudo headers (present in HTTP/2 and HTTP/3)\\\\n  must not be present.\\\\n\\\\n\\\\nReceive - ``receive`` event\\\\n'''''''''''''''''''''''''''\\\\n\\\\nSent to the application when a data message is received from the client.\\\\n\\\\nKeys:\\\\n\\\\n* ``type`` (*Unicode string*) -- ``\\\\\\\"websocket.receive\\\\\\\"``.\\\\n\\\\n* ``bytes`` (*byte string*) -- The message content, if it was binary\\\\n  mode, or ``None``. Optional; if missing, it is equivalent to\\\\n  ``None``.\\\\n\\\\n* ``text`` (*Unicode string*) -- The message content, if it was text\\\\n  mode, or ``None``. Optional; if missing, it is equivalent to\\\\n  ``None``.\\\\n\\\\nExactly one of ``bytes`` or ``text`` must be non-``None``. One or both\\\\nkeys may be present, however.\\\\n\\\\n\\\\nSend - ``send`` event\\\\n'''''''''''''''''''''\\\\n\\\\nSent by the application to send a data message to the client.\\\\n\\\\nKeys:\\\\n\\\\n* ``type`` (*Unicode string*) -- ``\\\\\\\"websocket.send\\\\\\\"``.\\\\n\\\\n* ``bytes`` (*byte string*) -- Binary message content, or ``None``.\\\\n   Optional; if missing, it is equivalent to ``None``.\\\\n\\\\n* ``text`` (*Unicode string*) -- Text message content, or ``None``.\\\\n   Optional; if missing, it is equivalent to ``None``.\\\\n\\\\nExactly one of ``bytes`` or ``text`` must be non-``None``. One or both\\\\nkeys may be present, however.\\\\n\\\\n\\\\n.. _disconnect-receive-event-ws:\\\\n\\\\nDisconnect - ``receive`` event\\\\n''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''\\\\n\\\\nSent to the application when either connection to the client is lost, either from\\\\nthe client closing the connection, the server closing the connection, or loss of the\\\\nsocket.\\\\n\\\\nOnce you have received this event, you should expect future calls to ``send()``\\\\nto raise an exception, as described below. However, if you have highly\\\\nconcurrent code, you may find calls to ``send()`` erroring slightly before you\\\\nreceive this event.\\\\n\\\\nKeys:\\\\n\\\\n* ``type`` (*Unicode string*) -- ``\\\\\\\"websocket.disconnect\\\\\\\"``\\\\n\\\\n* ``code`` (*int*) -- The WebSocket close code, as per the WebSocket spec. If no code\\\\n  was received in the frame from the client, the server should set this to ``1005``\\\\n  (the default value in the WebSocket specification).\\\\n\\\\n* ``reason`` (*Unicode string*) -- A reason given for the disconnect, can\\\\n  be any string. Optional; if missing or ``None`` default is empty\\\\n  string.\\\\n\\\\n\\\\nDisconnected Client - ``send`` exception\\\\n''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''''\\\\n\\\\nIf ``send()`` is called on a closed connection the server should raise\\\\na server-specific subclass of ``OSError``. This is not guaranteed, however,\\\\nespecially on older ASGI server implementations (it was introduced in spec\\\\nversion 2.4).\\\\n\\\\nApplications may catch this exception and do cleanup work before\\\\nre-raising it or returning with no exception.\\\\n\\\\nServers must be prepared to catch this exception if they raised it and\\\\nshould not log it as an error in their server logs.\\\\n\\\\n\\\\nClose - ``send`` event\\\\n''''''''''''''''''''''\\\\n\\\\nSent by the application to tell the server to close the connection.\\\\n\\\\nIf this is sent before the socket is accepted, the server\\\\nmust close the connection with a HTTP 403 error code\\\\n(Forbidden), and not complete the WebSocket handshake; this may present on some\\\\nbrowsers as a different WebSocket error code (such as 1006, Abnormal Closure).\\\\n\\\\nIf this is sent after the socket is accepted, the server must close the socket\\\\nwith the close code passed in the message (or 1000 if none is specified).\\\\n\\\\n* ``type`` (*Unicode string*) -- ``\\\\\\\"websocket.close\\\\\\\"``.\\\\n\\\\n* ``code`` (*int*) -- The WebSocket close code, as per the WebSocket\\\\n  spec.  Optional; if missing defaults to ``1000``.\\\\n\\\\n* ``reason`` (*Unicode string*) -- A reason given for the closure, can\\\\n  be any string. Optional; if missing or ``None`` default is empty\\\\n  string.\\\\n\\\\n\\\\nWSGI Compatibility\\\\n------------------\\\\n\\\\nPart of the design of the HTTP portion of this spec is to make sure it\\\\naligns well with the WSGI specification, to ensure easy adaptability\\\\nbetween both specifications and the ability to keep using WSGI\\\\napplications with ASGI servers.\\\\n\\\\nWSGI applications, being synchronous, must be run in a threadpool in order\\\\nto be served, but otherwise their runtime maps onto the HTTP connection scope's\\\\nlifetime.\\\\n\\\\nThere is an almost direct mapping for the various special keys in\\\\nWSGI's ``environ`` variable to the ``http`` scope:\\\\n\\\\n* ``REQUEST_METHOD`` is the ``method``\\\\n* ``SCRIPT_NAME`` is ``root_path``\\\\n* ``PATH_INFO`` can be derived by stripping ``root_path`` from ``path``\\\\n* ``QUERY_STRING`` is ``query_string``\\\\n* ``CONTENT_TYPE`` can be extracted from ``headers``\\\\n* ``CONTENT_LENGTH`` can be extracted from ``headers``\\\\n* ``SERVER_NAME`` and ``SERVER_PORT`` are in ``server``\\\\n* ``REMOTE_HOST``/``REMOTE_ADDR`` and ``REMOTE_PORT`` are in ``client``\\\\n* ``SERVER_PROTOCOL`` is encoded in ``http_version``\\\\n* ``wsgi.url_scheme`` is ``scheme``\\\\n* ``wsgi.input`` is a ``StringIO`` based around the ``http.request`` messages\\\\n* ``wsgi.errors`` is directed by the wrapper as needed\\\\n\\\\nThe ``start_response`` callable maps similarly to ``http.response.start``:\\\\n\\\\n* The ``status`` argument becomes ``status``, with the reason phrase dropped.\\\\n* ``response_headers`` maps to ``headers``\\\\n\\\\nYielding content from the WSGI application maps to sending\\\\n``http.response.body`` messages.\\\\n\\\\n\\\\nWSGI encoding differences\\\\n-------------------------\\\\n\\\\nThe WSGI specification (as defined in PEP 3333) specifies that all strings\\\\nsent to or from the server must be of the ``str`` type but only contain\\\\ncodepoints in the ISO-8859-1 (\\\\\\\"latin-1\\\\\\\") range. This was due to it originally\\\\nbeing designed for Python 2 and its different set of string types.\\\\n\\\\nThe ASGI HTTP and WebSocket specifications instead specify each entry of the\\\\n``scope`` dict as either a byte string or a Unicode string. HTTP, being an\\\\nolder protocol, is sometimes imperfect at specifying encoding, so some\\\\ndecisions of what is Unicode versus bytes may not be obvious.\\\\n\\\\n* ``path``: URLs can have both percent-encoded and UTF-8 encoded sections.\\\\n  Because decoding these is often done by the underlying server (or sometimes\\\\n  even proxies in the path), this is a Unicode string, fully decoded from both\\\\n  UTF-8 encoding and percent encodings.\\\\n\\\\n* ``headers``: These are byte strings of the exact byte sequences sent by the\\\\n  client/to be sent by the server. While modern HTTP standards say that headers\\\\n  should be ASCII, older ones did not and allowed a wider range of characters.\\\\n  Frameworks/applications should decode headers as they deem appropriate.\\\\n\\\\n* ``query_string``: Unlike the ``path``, this is not as subject to server\\\\n  interference and so is presented as its raw byte string version,\\\\n  percent-encoded.\\\\n\\\\n* ``root_path``: Unicode string to match ``path``.\\\\n\\\\n\\\\nVersion History\\\\n---------------\\\\n\\\\n\\\\n* 2.0 (2017-11-28): Initial non-channel-layer based ASGI 间隔与用户时间\\\\n\\\\n延迟指标不是一个孤立数值，而是一组契约：从哪个事件开始、到哪个事件结束、在哪个时钟域观测、覆盖哪些请求、以什么完成和质量规则筛选、按什么顺序聚合。名字相同而任一契约不同，数值就不可直接比较。服务优化的目标，是把“模型产生内容”与“用户能够消费内容”连起来，而不是只让某个内部阶段变快。\\\\n\\\\n## 事件词汇、时间域与请求状态\\\\n\\\\n对请求尝试 r，至少区分以下事件。每个事件应带请求/尝试身份、事件类型、时间戳、时钟域、产生位置和顺序号；只有时间戳不足以把重试、代理转发或两条连接上的消息配对。\\\\n\\\\n| 符号 | 事件 | 典型用途 | 不能自动代表 |\\\\n|---|---|---|---|\\\\n| a_r | 客户端发送或提交请求 | 客户端 TTFT、端到端延迟的起点 | 服务已经接收 |\\\\n| s_r | 服务接收请求 | 服务内部 TTFT 的起点 | 已获准入或已开始执行 |\\\\n| q_r | 准入、排队或开始执行 | 区分排队与执行 | 首个内容已产生 |\\\\n| g_r | 模型产生首个 token 或首个可解码单位 | 内部执行诊断 | 用户已经看见内容 |\\\\n| v_{r,j} | 第 j 个客户端可见内容块的时间 | 首个/最后内容、ITL | 服务已封包或客户端已消费 |\\\\n| f_r | 服务侧终止事件 | 成功、错误、超时、取消或协议完成 | 客户端已经收到最终内容 |\\\\n| u_r | 客户端消费最后内容或连接结束 | 用户完成时间 | 服务资源已经释放 |\\\\n\\\\n令 m_{r,j} 为第 j 个内容块中新可见的内容 token 数，取非负整数。内容块是 m_{r,j}>0 的块；角色消息、心跳、usage 元数据、空 delta 和仅表示响应开始的块都不自动成为首个内容。一个块可以含多个 token，因此客户端块时间不是逐 token 时间。\\\\n\\\\n请求尝试的状态可以写成：OFFERED，然后进入 REJECTED，或进入 ADMITTED、FIRST_CONTENT、STREAMING、TERMINAL。合法路径还包括 ADMITTED 直接到 TERMINAL，例如执行失败、超时或取消而没有内容。TERMINAL 必须带一个权威原因；同一个 terminal_id 的重复通知可以幂等忽略，两个不同 terminal_id 同时到达则记为 AMBIGUOUS，不能静默选择其中一个。TERMINAL 之后到达的内容不能写回该尝试；如果它属于重试，必须使用新的尝试身份。窗口结束时仍无终态的请求是 PENDING，不是成功完成的请求。\\\\n\\\\n“发送成功”“已交给发送缓冲”“客户端收到”是不同事件。固定 ASGI 规范说明，http.response.start 不必立即刷新到发送缓冲，服务器可以等到第一个 response body 再发送响应头；http.response.body 的 send 返回时，数据必须已交给服务器发送缓冲，但这不确认远端应用已经消费。客户端断开通知与 send 失败还可能存在竞争。因此，协议完成、业务终态和用户最后收到内容需要分别记录。\\\\n\\\\n## 从可见内容块计算 TTFT、ITL 与 TPOT\\\\n\\\\n对请求 r，记 M_r 为可见内容块数，N_r 为可见内容 token 总数：\\\\n\\\\nN_r = Σ_{j=1}^{M_r} m_{r,j}，M_r = |{j: m_{r,j}>0}|。\\\\n\\\\n客户端 TTFT 和服务侧 TTFT 至少有两种定义：\\\\n\\\\nTTFT_client(r) = v_{r,1} − a_r，TTFT_server(r) = v_{r,1} − s_r。\\\\n\\\\n如果使用模型首个 token 时间 g_r，则应明确写成内部首 token 时间；它不包含去 tokenizer、停止串缓冲或网络交付，不能替代用户 TTFT。若没有可见内容，v_{r,1} 未定义，TTFT 不能写成零。端到端请求延迟通常写成 f_r − a_r 或 u_r − a_r，必须注明用的是服务终止还是客户端最后消费。\\\\n\\\\n当 M_r≥2 且 N_r>1 时，可以定义“首末可见跨度除以全部输出 token 数减一”的粗粒度 TPOT：\\\\n\\\\nspan_tpot(r) = (v_{r,M_r} − v_{r,1}) / (N_r − 1)。\\\\n\\\\n它使用首末内容块时间，不能恢复块内每个 token 的真实时间；若同一块中的 token 同时可见，这个量主要描述可见跨度。若 M_r=1 而 N_r>1，所有 token 在同一内容块中到达，没有可观测的逐块间隔，不应把 span_tpot 当作真实逐 token 延迟。\\\\n\\\\n逐块 ITL 以“后一个块中的 token 数”作分母，和 GenAI-Perf 固定 Metrics 表的口径一致：\\\\n\\\\nI_{r,j} = (v_{r,j} − v_{r,j−1}) / m_{r,j}，j=2,…,M_r。\\\\n\\\\n这里 I_{r,j} 的单位是时间/token；m_{r,j} 是后一个块新增的可见 token 数，不是前一个块，也不能用块数代替 token 数。m_{r,j}=0 的事件不是内容块，不产生 ITL 样本。若后一个块含 2 个 token、块间时间为 10 ms，则该块 ITL 为 5 ms/token；把它写成 10 ms/token 是把块间隔误当 token 间隔。\\\\n\\\\n同一批 ITL 至少有两种不同的汇总：\\\\n\\\\nchunk_mean_ITL(r) = (1/(M_r−1)) Σ_{j=2}^{M_r} I_{r,j}，\\\\n\\\\ntoken_weighted_ITL(r) = (v_{r,M_r} − v_{r,1}) / Σ_{j=2}^{M_r} m_{r,j}。\\\\n\\\\n前者给每个内容块相同权重，后者给后续内容 token 加权。span_tpot 的分母 N_r−1 又包含首个块中的 token，因此三者一般不相等。设 v_{r,1}=0 s、m_{r,1}=5，v_{r,2}=2 s、m_{r,2}=1，v_{r,3}=4 s、m_{r,3}=4。则 N_r=10、M_r=3，I_{r,2}=2 s/token，I_{r,3}=0.5 s/token；chunk_mean_ITL=1.25 s/token，token_weighted_ITL=4/5=0.8 s/token，span_tpot=4/9≈0.444 s/token。这些数字回答不同问题：首块 5 个 token 同时可见，span 把它们的零内部间隔也计入分母，token_weighted 则只统计后续块中的 token。只报告一个“平均 ITL”而不报告 M_r、N_r 和每块 token 数，读者无法复算。\\\\n\\\\nGenAI-Perf 还把 Time to Second Token 定义为第一个流式响应到第二个流式响应的时间；流式响应可能仍是 chunk，不能自动当作 token。其 ITL 是一个响应对应一个值，再按请求汇总。不同工具即使字段同名，也要核对首个 response 是否包括空角色消息、后续响应是否按 token 数归一。\\\\n\\\\n## 合法性与完成事件的选择\\\\n\\\\n把时间差解释为指标，至少要满足以下条件。\\\\n\\\\n第一，事件身份和范围一致。HTTP/2 连接复用多个请求时，连接身份不能代替请求身份；ASGI 的 HTTP scope 按请求建立，而 WebSocket 连接 scope 可以持续多个任务，服务必须另行定义每条任务、回合和输出的归属。重试沿用原请求 ID 时，还要有尝试身份，否则旧终态可能被配到新请求。\\\\n\\\\n第二，内容事件的语义一致。只把 m_{r,j}>0 的可见内容块计入首个/最后内容和 ITL；空角色消息、心跳、usage 和响应头不是内容。ASGI 的 response.start 也不保证已发送到客户端。若工具把首个 response 而不是首个非空内容作为 TTFT，它回答的是另一个问题，不能仅凭字段名字判断等价。\\\\n\\\\n第三，时间顺序和时钟域合法。同一时钟域内，内容事件应按可见顺序非递减；时间倒退不能靠重新排序掩盖，因为排序可能制造不存在的因果顺序。跨机器相减需要偏移界限。设 A 时钟读数为 a、B 时钟读数为 b，B 相对 A 的偏移 δ=t_B−t_A 位于 [δ_lo, δ_hi]，则单向经过时间满足：\\\\n\\\\nT ∈ [b − a − δ_hi, b − a − δ_lo] ∩ [0, ∞)。\\\\n\\\\n例如 a=10 ms、b=15 ms、δ∈[−2,4] ms，得到 T∈[1,7] ms；δ∈[4,8] ms 时得到 T∈[0,1] ms。若交集为空，不能把负下界静默改成零，应先检查身份、事件语义或校准界限。很短的网络或设备阶段可能和时钟量化误差同量级，报告值应保留测量粒度。\\\\n\\\\n第四，终态必须唯一且符合任务。正常结束、错误、超时、取消、客户端断开和内部中止应进入同一请求终止账务，但分类不同。成功不仅要求有终态，还要求任务规定的输出和质量条件满足。客户端断开与 send 失败可能先后不定；一次 send 返回也不能证明客户端已消费。\\\\n\\\\n不同任务的可交付完成事件不同：\\\\n\\\\n| 任务 | 可交付结果的事件 | 需要同时保留的条件 |\\\\n|---|---|---|\\\\n| 多轮会话或工具流程 | 必要依赖完成且最终回答可用 | 中间回合、工具失败、取消、会话级质量 |\\\\n| Embedding | 全部规定向量已返回且可消费 | 输入条数、维度、归一化、检索质量 |\\\\n| 检索与 reranking | 满足过滤规则的排序结果可用 | top-k、候选集、索引版本、recall 或排序质量 |\\\\n| 图像生成或识别 | 完整图像或规定预测结果可用 | 分辨率、预处理、生成步数、质量 |\\\\n| 语音识别 | 首个稳定文本与最终转录分别可用 | 音频窗口、修订规则、词错误率 |\\\\n| 语音或视频生成 | 可连续消费的包及完整输出 | 播放时长、供给间隙、帧顺序、联合质量 |\\\\n\\\\n生成 tokens/s 不能替代这些任务的完成率。一个会话有五次模型调用时，五个请求返回成功，不证明整个工具流程成功；embedding 把长文档分成更多块，也不能直接算作业务吞吐增加。\\\\n\\\\n第五，分类必须互斥且可核对。在固定截止点，至少保留：\\\\n\\\\noffered = rejected + admitted，\\\\nadmitted = terminal + pending + uncertain，\\\\nterminal = good + quality_fail + deadline_fail + error + cancel。\\\\n\\\\n其中 rejected 是未进入执行的拒绝，pending 是尚未得到终态，uncertain 是冲突终态或无法关联的样本；good 是同时满足完成、质量和时延约束的请求。若服务把拒绝也作为最终响应计入 request throughput，应另列 rejected，不能和 admitted 后的 terminal 混在一起。\\\\n\\\\n## 算法：一个流式指标归约器\\\\n\\\\n下面的归约器只处理同一个请求尝试、同一个可见时钟域的事件；跨域事件先按合法界限转换，否则拒绝。它不保存完整文本，只保存计算指标需要的状态。\\\\n\\\\n```pseudocode\\\\n算法 REDUCE_REQUEST(events)\\\\n输入：按 event_seq 排列的单个请求尝试事件；事件含 type、ts、clock、m、terminal_id、reason\\\\n输出：TTFT、可见 token 数、内容块数、逐块 ITL、span_tpot、token_weighted_ITL、终态；或 PENDING / AMBIGUOUS / 错误\\\\n\\\\n初始化：\\\\n  offered_ts = 空；admitted = false\\\\n  terminal = 空；ambiguous = false\\\\n  first_content = 空；prev_content_ts = 空；last_content_ts = 空\\\\n  total_tokens = 0；content_chunks = 0；first_chunk_tokens = 0\\\\n  itl = 空；reported_usage = 空\\\\n\\\\nfor e in events:\\\\n    检查 e.ts 有限；内容事件必须满足 e.ts >= prev_content_ts\\\\n    if e.type == offer:\\\\n        若 offered_ts 已存在则错误\\\\n        offered_ts = e.ts\\\\n    elif e.type == admit:\\\\n        要求 offered_ts 已存在、admitted 为 false、terminal 为空\\\\n        admitted = true\\\\n    elif e.type == chunk:\\\\n        要求 admitted 为 true、terminal 为空、e.m 为不小于零的整数\\\\n        if e.m == 0:\\\\n            记录为空事件；不改变 first_content、last_content、total_tokens\\\\n        else:\\\\n            if first_content 为空:\\\\n                first_content = e.ts\\\\n                first_chunk_tokens = e.m\\\\n            else:\\\\n                要求 e.ts >= prev_content_ts\\\\n                itl.append((e.ts - prev_content_ts) / e.m)\\\\n            total_tokens = total_tokens + e.m\\\\n            content_chunks = content_chunks + 1\\\\n            prev_content_ts = e.ts\\\\n            last_content_ts = e.ts\\\\n    elif e.type == usage:\\\\n        reported_usage = e.tokens；只作对账，不改变可见 token 计数\\\\n    elif e.type == terminal:\\\\n        要求 terminal_id 非空\\\\n        if terminal 为空:\\\\n            terminal = e\\\\n        elif e.terminal_id == terminal.terminal_id:\\\\n            忽略重复终态\\\\n        else:\\\\n            ambiguous = true\\\\n    else:\\\\n        未知事件若可能影响内容或终态则拒绝；纯遥测元数据可保留但不进入指标\\\\n\\\\n完成：\\\\n  要求 offered_ts 非空\\\\n  if terminal 为空: 返回 PENDING\\\\n  if ambiguous: 返回 AMBIGUOUS\\\\n  if first_content 为空:\\\\n      TTFT = 未定义；N = total_tokens；M = 0；ITL 为空\\\\n  else:\\\\n      TTFT = first_content - offered_ts\\\\n  if content_chunks >= 2 且 total_tokens > 1:\\\\n      span_tpot = (last_content_ts - first_content) / (total_tokens - 1)\\\\n      later_tokens = total_tokens - first_chunk_tokens\\\\n      token_weighted_ITL = (last_content_ts - first_content) / later_tokens\\\\n      chunk_mean_ITL = sum(itl) / len(itl)\\\\n  else:\\\\n      span_tpot、token_weighted_ITL、chunk_mean_ITL 均未定义\\\\n  返回 TTFT、total_tokens、content_chunks、itl、上述汇总量和终态\\\\n```\\\\n\\\\n该归约器的不变量是：content_chunks 等于 m>0 的块数；itl 长度为 content_chunks−1；total_tokens 等于所有 m>0 块的和；first_chunk_tokens 等于首个内容块的 m；token_weighted_ITL 乘以后续块 token 总数等于 last_content_ts−first_content；usage 中的 token 数不自动成为可见 token 数。内容事件时间倒退、内容出现在终态之后、重复终态冲突和未知语义事件都应被拒绝或标为不确定，而不是产生一个看似精确的延迟。\\\\n\\\\n固定到达窗口的聚合可以单独写成：\\\\n\\\\n```pseudocode\\\\n算法 AGGREGATE_COHORT(requests, W0, W1, D)\\\\n输入：请求尝试集合；到达窗口 [W0, W1)；排空观察截止 D，D >= W1\\\\n输出：offered、rejected、admitted、terminal、pending、uncertain、good、goodput、request_throughput\\\\n\\\\nT = D - W0\\\\nif T <= 0: 拒绝\\\\nfor r in requests:\\\\n    if not (W0 <= r.arrival < W1): 跳过\\\\n    offered = offered + 1\\\\n    if r.rejected:\\\\n        rejected = rejected + 1\\\\n        continue\\\\n    admitted = admitted + 1\\\\n    if r.status == PENDING or r.terminal_ts 为空 or r.terminal_ts > D:\\\\n        pending = pending + 1\\\\n        continue\\\\n    if r.status == AMBIGUOUS:\\\\n        uncertain = uncertain + 1\\\\n        continue\\\\n    terminal = terminal + 1\\\\n    if r.terminal_reason == ok 且 r.quality_ok 且 r.slo_ok:\\\\n        good = good + 1\\\\n\\\\n要求 offered == rejected + admitted\\\\n要求 admitted == terminal + pending + uncertain\\\\n要求 good <= terminal\\\\ngoodput = good / T\\\\nrequest_throughput = terminal / T\\\\n返回上述计数与速率；若还要把拒绝响应计入请求吞吐，另报 (terminal + rejected) / T\\\\n```\\\\n\\\\n这个聚合器把“发出但未完成”“拒绝”“冲突终态”和“已终态但质量失败”分开。D 是观察截止而不是理想完成时刻；为了得到稳定速率，必须说明为何 D 足以覆盖目标工作，或者把未完成量作为容量证据保留。\\\\n\\\\n## 窗口、群体与分母\\\\n\\\\n吞吐的分母必须和分子属于同一窗口。至少有两种常见选择。\\\\n\\\\n固定到达窗口选择到达时间在 [W0,W1) 的请求，再观察至 D；若用 T=D−W0 作分母，分子可以包括窗口结束后才完成的同一批请求。若坚持用 W1−W0 作分母，却把窗口后完成的工作算进分子，就会把未来工作计入过去窗口；若只保留 W1 前完成的请求，则会系统性排除长请求。\\\\n\\\\n完成窗口选择终态时间落在 [W0,W1) 的请求，分母 T=W1−W0。它适合回答“这一时间段完成了多少”，但长请求可能因完成较晚而被排除，窗口结束时仍有 pending 队列。报告应同时保留窗口边界、终态时间和残留队列，不能只留下快速完成的样本。\\\\n\\\\n请求吞吐通常写成 N_terminal/T；如果分母只包含成功请求，就是另一个指标。输出 token 吞吐通常写成 ΣN_r/T，但还要说明 token 是按请求终态归入窗口，还是按 token 可见时间归入窗口。GenAI-Perf 固定文档把 output token throughput 写成总输出 token 除以 benchmark duration；这仍要求先说明 benchmark 的请求集合、完成条件和窗口。\\\\n\\\\ngoodput 是满足约束的完成请求率：\\\\n\\\\ngoodput = Σ_r 1[complete_r ∧ quality_r ∧ SLO_r] / T。\\\\n\\\\n质量门和时延门必须同时成立；TTFT 合格率和 ITL 合格率各自的 95% 不保证同一批请求的联合合格率也是 95%。若 N_good=0，单位合格结果成本、goodput 等比值不可写成零，应标为不可用。\\\\n\\\\n一个设定窗口 T=10 s：发出 100 个请求，10 个被拒绝，90 个获接收；80 个终态完成，10 个仍未完成，完成的 80 个中 72 个同时满足质量与全部时延约束。则 good 数为 72，goodput=7.2 请求/s，合格请求占发出请求的比例为 72%，已终态请求率为 8 请求/s；如果拒绝也产生最终响应且任务选择计入 request throughput，则所有最终响应率为 9 请求/s。三个分母回答不同问题，不能用只保留 80 个完成请求的方式重新定义。\\\\n\\\\n## 成本：事件、存储与同步\\\\n\\\\n单请求归约的时间成本是 O(M_r)，M_r 为内容块数；只保留 TTFT、总 token 数和终态时，额外空间为 O(1)。若要保存每条 ITL 以计算全局 p99，样本数 S=Σ(M_r−1)，精确排序需要 O(S log S) 时间和 O(S) 空间；只算均值可以 O(1) 累加，但尾部需要样本或近似摘要，摘要会引入误差。M_r 可能远小于 N_r：一个块含很多 token 时，ITL 样本数仍只有 M_r−1，不能把 N_r 个 token 当作 N_r 个独立间隔。若 M_r=1，逐块 ITL 样本为零，只能报告首内容、总 token 和块内突发。\\\\n\\\\n准备成本包括解析流事件、识别内容块、去 tokenizer 或停止串缓冲、重新 tokenization 和把响应与请求身份关联。token 计数依赖 tokenizer 版本和特殊 token 规则；固定 GenAI-Perf 文档也提示 token 数可能不完全精确。usage 可以用于对账，但它是否包含被停止串隐藏的内容、候选或被取消的在途 token，需要按接口说明确认，不能假定 usage 与可见内容相等。\\\\n\\\\n通信成本取决于块粒度。更小的块增加事件数、响应头/解析/唤醒和记录开销，也可能降低批处理机会；更大的块减少事件和封包，却让块内 token 时间不可见，并增大首个内容的突发。没有脱离任务的统一最佳块大小。记录本身也可能引入同步、刷新和缓冲驻留；trace 的额外开销应和正常运行测量分开报告。\\\\n\\\\n同步成本包括读取时间戳、跨进程/跨机器校准、等待发送缓冲、flush 和 trace 导出。TTFT 的关键路径可能包含准入排队、预处理、prefill、首步执行、去 tokenizer、停止串缓冲和网络；这些阶段可能重叠，不能把各段耗时直接相加。设备 kernel 时间只是内部执行的一段时间，不是用户 TTFT。相关的主机/设备区间、因果边和并集计算见主机与设备时间条目。\\\\n\\\\n驻留成本包括每请求归约状态、待发送内容、停止串窗口、原始事件日志和响应缓冲。流式归约可以保持 O(1) 状态，但审计要求保存原始 chunk 或 payload 时，驻留量随输出字节和窗口增长；p99 精确计算还要保存 ITL 样本。\\\\n\\\\n## 条件变化后的保留、调整与放弃\\\\n\\\\n块粒度改变时，保留首个/最后可见内容、总 token 和终态；如果只有块时间，就放弃“逐 token 精确间隔”的主张，改报逐块 ITL，并同时报告 M_r、N_r 和每块 token 数。比较两个块策略时，若一个把三个 token 合成一块，另一个逐 token 发送，二者的 p99 ITL 不可直接相减；应看总可见跨度、块内突发和用户侧停顿，或取得 token 级时间后重算。\\\\n\\\\n从流式改成整段返回时，只有一个响应体事件；可以测请求延迟和总 token 数，不能把最终响应时间当作首 token 时间，也不能从单块恢复 ITL。若业务只需要最终文本，整段返回仍是合法选择，但用户无法观察中间内容，TTFT 与流式服务不是同一指标。\\\\n\\\\n停止串、去 tokenizer 和格式后处理会推迟首个可见内容。模型首个 token 时间可以用于诊断，用户 TTFT 必须绑定可见内容事件；若停止串需要保留一段待确认文本，服务不应把内部已生成的 token 数直接当作已交付内容。\\\\n\\\\n取消和重试会改变终态分类。客户端断开、send 失败和内部取消可能竞争；固定 ASGI 规范说明，收到 disconnect 后未来 send 通常应失败，但高并发代码可能先看到 send 异常，再看到 disconnect。一次 send 返回不等于远端已消费，一次 send 异常也不自动证明设备工作已经停止。取消请求若已有可见内容，是否算部分成功由任务定义；迟到结果不能写回已终止的旧尝试。重试必须保留请求身份和尝试代次，否则重复终态会增加 good 计数。\\\\n\\\\n输出长度变化会改变请求吞吐和 token 吞吐的权重。更短输出可能让每秒请求数上升，却降低每个请求的有效内容；在比较前应固定质量、输出长度分布和完成规则，或把长度作为分层变量报告。开放到达与闭环用户也不可混用：闭环用户在本轮响应后才发下一轮，系统变慢会自动降低请求率，不能据此证明固定外部到达下仍有同样容量。\\\\n\\\\n多轮会话和工具流程应把请求级 TTFT/ITL 与会话级完成时间分开。后续回合可能依赖前一轮输出、工具结果或检索版本；五次模型调用都成功，不等于整个会话成功。语音、图像、embedding 和 ranking 应使用各自完成事件：语音关注首个可播放包、累计音频时长和供给间隙；图像关注完整图像或明确预测；embedding 关注全部向量；ranking 关注过滤后的 top-k 和排序质量。\\\\n\\\\n设备或执行路径变化后，保留用户可见事件，重新检查关键路径。内部 kernel 加速若被排队、去 tokenizer 或发送缓冲掩盖，用户 TTFT 可以不变；这不是说 kernel 优化无效，而是说它没有改变当前指标的关键路径。涉及 GPU 的结论必须由目标设备事件和测量支持，本章的公式不能替代设备实测。\\\\n\\\\n## 竞争解释与区分实验\\\\n\\\\n| 观察 | 竞争解释 | 区分干预 | 预测与修正 |\\\\n|---|---|---|---|\\\\n| TTFT 突然变小，但首个内容时间未变 | 首个空响应、角色消息被当成内容，或缓存改变了真正首内容 | 分别解析全部响应与仅非空内容；注入空角色消息 | 只有内容解析改变而真实首内容不变时，修正解析器；不能把空事件当用户首内容 |\\\\n| 吞吐上升 | 输出变短、拒绝增加、未完成被删除、窗口改变或并发提高 | 固定输出长度、质量、offered 和窗口；报告 pending/rejected | 输出 token 下降或 pending 增加时，收益来自任务或分母改变，不是同一有效吞吐 |\\\\n| p99 ITL 变差 | 真实停顿，或块合并、tokenizer 版本、分母改变 | 固定输出与到达；比较总可见跨度、M、每块 token 数和 token 级轨迹 | 总跨度不变而 p99 随块大小改变，支持聚合解释；总跨度也变差才支持真实停顿 |\\\\n| 内部 kernel 变快，TTFT 不变 | 排队、去 tokenizer、停止串或网络成为关键路径 | 增加服务接收、首模型 token、首可见内容和客户端收到事件 | 内部阶段提前而可见内容不提前，不能声称用户 TTFT 改善 |\\\\n| send 返回早，客户端收到晚 | 发送缓冲、代理缓冲或客户端消费慢 | 固定服务、延迟客户端读取；记录 send、最后字节和客户端消费 | send 时间不变而客户端时间后移，支持交付解释；不要用 send 返回代替用户完成 |\\\\n| 跨机出现负延迟或异常小延迟 | 时钟偏移、事件身份错配或不同时间域 | 保留偏移界限，同时比较客户端本地完成与往返 | 只有对齐变化支持时钟解释；界限仍宽则结论是未区分 |\\\\n| 重复终态或重试后 good 增加 | 同一尝试被计两次，或不同尝试共享 terminal_id | 重放相同 terminal_id；再注入不同 terminal_id | good 应不变；不同终态应标为 AMBIGUOUS，不能静默选一个 |\\\\n| 取消后仍有输出或状态变化 | send 异常早于 disconnect、取消未到达设备或迟到提交 | 在首内容前、内容中、终态后分别注入断开；记录资源释放 | 仅在最后设备使用者结束后才可复用；send 异常本身不证明清理完成 |\\\\n\\\\n几个小型反例可以检出常见错误。第一，5 ms 到达空角色块、100 ms 才出现首个非空内容；若把任何 chunk 当首内容，会报告 5 ms，正确的内容 TTFT 应为 100 ms。第二，N=2 且首末可见内容相隔 100 ms；按 (N−1) 计算得到 100 ms/token，按 N 计算得到 50 ms/token，后者是错误分母。第三，两个请求的逐请求 p99 分别为 10 ms 和 2 ms，平均为 6 ms；把全部间隔合并后 p99 可能仍是 10 ms，平均逐请求 p99 不是全局 p99。小样本只用于说明聚合顺序，不用于尾部精度结论。第四，10 个发出请求中 6 个合格、4 个未完成；正确 good 比例是 0.6，把 pending 当完成会得到 1.0。第五，若某内容块新增 2 个 token、块间相隔 10 ms，逐块 ITL 是 5 ms/token，不是 10 ms/token。\\\\n\\\\n## 一个端到端轨迹算例\\\\n\\\\n以下均为设定值，使用同一个客户端可见时钟，不声称来自实测。\\\\n\\\\n| 事件 | 时间/ms | 处理 |\\\\n|---|---|---|\\\\n| 客户端发送 a | 0 | 指标起点 |\\\\n| 服务接收 s | 2 | 服务内部起点 |\\\\n| 准入 q | 4 | 排队与执行分界 |\\\\n| 空角色块 | 20 | 不是内容，忽略 |\\\\n| 模型首 token g | 70 | 内部诊断事件 |\\\\n| 首个可见内容 v₁，m=3 | 100 | 用户 TTFT 终点 |\\\\n| 第二内容 v₂，m=2 | 120 | 产生一个逐块 ITL |\\\\n| 最后内容 v₃，m=1 | 150 | 最后可见内容 |\\\\n| usage，tokens=6 | 152 | 对账，不改变可见 token 数 |\\\\n| 服务终态 f | 160 | 服务完成 |\\\\n| 客户端最后接收 u | 180 | 用户完成 |\\\\n\\\\n该轨迹中 TTFT_client=100 ms，TTFT_server=98 ms，内部首 token 时间为 70 ms，但它不是用户首内容。N=6，M=3；I₂=(120−100)/2=10 ms/token，I₃=(150−120)/1=30 ms/token；chunk_mean_ITL=(10+30)/2=20 ms/token；token_weighted_ITL=(150−100)/(2+1)=16.67 ms/token；span_tpot=(150−100)/(6−1)=10 ms/token。端到端请求延迟若用客户端最后接收为 180 ms；服务终态到客户端最后接收还有 20 ms 的交付尾部。\\\\n\\\\n若解析器把 20 ms 的空角色块当首内容，会得到错误的 20 ms TTFT；若用内部首 token 70 ms，会得到内部指标而非用户指标。若所有 6 个 token 都在 100 ms 一个块中到达，则没有逐块 ITL 样本，只能报告首内容、总 token 和块内突发；若 N=1，则 TPOT 未定义，不能写零。\\\\n\\\\n## 来源与推导\\\\n\\\\n- [S-GENAI-PERF：NVIDIA 间隔与用户时间\\\\n\\\\n一个延迟指标是两个有身份的事件之间的时间差；指标名字相同而事件定义、时间域或分母不同，会得到不同结论。服务指标还要说明观察对象是客户端可见内容、服务端发送、设备执行还是任务最终完成，不能把这些边界混成一个数。\\\\n\\\\n## 问题、事件对象与不变量\\\\n\\\\n生成服务的可观察过程是异步的：请求先被接收，随后排队、预处理、执行和流式交付；模型已经产生 token、服务已经写入发送缓冲、客户端已经显示字符是不同事件。指标系统的任务不是给这些事件改名字，而是保存足够身份，使每个数值可以还原为一条明确的差分或聚合。\\\\n\\\\n一次观测至少写成\\\\n\\\\n`e = (r, g, k, t, d, s, p)`。\\\\n\\\\n其中 `r` 是请求或会话身份，`g` 是尝试或输出代次，`k` 是事件类型，`t` 是时间读数，`d` 是时间域（客户端、服务进程、设备或外部压测器），`s` 是作用域（连接、请求、批或设备队列），`p` 是负载身份（内容、token 范围、chunk 序号、usage 或空事件）。时间统一采用同一单位；跨时间域时另行保存偏移界限，而不是把两个读数直接相减后称为精确延迟。\\\\n\\\\n本章使用的请求记录 `REQUEST_RECORD` 至少包含：逻辑请求身份、尝试代次、到达时间、准入结果、首次执行时间、首个模型 token 时间、首个用户可见内容时间、最后内容时间、协议结束时间、客户端完成时间、输出 token 数、内容 chunk 表、终止原因（完成、拒绝、取消、超时、失败）以及质量与 SLO 判定。状态的含义必须区分：已接收不等于已准入，已产生 token 不等于已交付内容，协议完成不等于客户端已经消费，取消标志也不等于设备上的最后访问已经结束。\\\\n\\\\n本章依赖以下不变量。\\\\n\\\\n1. 事件有稳定身份。重试、旧代次、迟到回调、同一物理工作的重复导出不能自动合并成一条事件；合并前必须证明它们是同一逻辑事件。\\\\n2. 内容事件与元数据事件分开。空角色消息、心跳、usage、响应头、预览标记和真正的首个内容不是同一事件。\\\\n3. token 与传输 chunk 分开。一个 chunk 可以包含零个、一个或多个模型 token；客户端只能直接观测 chunk 到达时，不能凭空恢复 chunk 内部的 token 时间。\\\\n4. 时间差只在同一时间域或已证明的偏移区间内解释。trace 身份可以连接因果，不自动提供时钟同步。\\\\n5. 分母与聚合对象显式保存。`N=1` 没有 token 间隔；每请求平均、按间隔合并、每请求分位数和全局分位数回答不同问题。\\\\n6. 窗口内的拒绝、失败、取消、超时和未完成请求不能从账本中消失。吞吐、成功率和 goodput 的分母必须与实际观察集合一致。\\\\n\\\\n## 事件时间轴与指标定义\\\\n\\\\n记客户端发送为 `t_0`，服务接收为 `t_R`，开始执行为 `t_X`，首个模型 token 为 `t_M`，首个用户可见内容为 `t_1`，最后一个用户可见内容为 `t_N`，协议结束为 `t_F`，客户端确认完成为 `t_C`。所有时间使用同一单位，例如毫秒；若使用不同时间域，只保留带界限的区间。\\\\n\\\\n常用定义如下。\\\\n\\\\n- 客户端 TTFT：`TTFT_client = t_1 - t_0`。它包含网络、排队、预处理、首步执行、内容过滤和首个 chunk 的交付。\\\\n- 服务内部首内容延迟：`TTFT_server = t_1 - t_R` 或 `t_1 - t_X`，取决于起点。它不能与客户端 TTFT 共用同一个名字后直接比较。\\\\n- 请求完成延迟：`L_request = t_F - t_0`；客户端总时间：`L_user = t_C - t_0`。后者还包含最后封包、传输、解析和客户端提交。\\\\n- 设输出有 `N` 个用户可见内容 token，且有精确 token 时间。平均 TPOT 为 `TPOT_avg = (t_N - t_1) / (N - 1)`，仅当 `N > 1`。`N=1` 时没有 token 间隔，应报告 TTFT 或请求完成延迟，并把 TPOT 标为未定义，不能除以零或写成零。\\\\n- 第 `i` 个 token 间隔为 `ITL_i = t_i - t_(i-1)`，`i=1..N-1`。p99 ITL 是这些间隔上的尾部分位数，不是平均 TPOT 的 p99，也不能由平均 TPOT 推断。\\\\n- 单请求的输出 token 速率若定义为除首 token 外的生成量除以生成持续时间，则为 `(N - 1) / (t_N - t_1)`，仅在 `N>1` 且时间可解释时有意义。\\\\n\\\\n传输 chunk 带来额外边界。设第 `k` 个内容 chunk 在 `τ_k` 可见，携带 `m_k` 个 token，累计 token 数为 `C_k = Σ_{j≤k} m_j`。若 chunk 内没有逐 token 时间，则 `τ_k` 只能给出该 chunk 的可见时刻；chunk 内 token 的时间属于一个不可直接区分的区间。此时可以从 chunk 时间构造一个明确命名的近似量：`chunk_ITL_k = (τ_k - τ_(k-1)) / m_k`，但它不等于精确逐 token ITL，除非 `m_k=1` 或另有均匀间隔等假设。\\\\n\\\\n一个特别容易被误算的边界是：所有 `N>1` 个 token 都在同一个 chunk 中。此时用首 chunk 和末 chunk 的端点相减会得到零，再除以 `N-1` 会报告零 TPOT；这不是快，而是 token 时间不可观测。正确做法是保留 TTFT 和 chunk 可见时间，把精确 TPOT 标为不可用；若要报告近似值，必须把它命名为 chunk 级估计并说明假设。\\\\n\\\\n## 从协议事件到内容 token：合法映射\\\\n\\\\n首个内容事件必须由任务和协议共同定义。文本流中的角色消息、空 delta、usage、结束标记和工具调用元数据通常不是用户可见内容；stop string 检测、detokenization 缓冲、内容过滤和代理压缩又可能让模型已经产生的 token 暂时不可见。指标应同时保存模型 token 时间、服务端内容事件时间和客户端收到时间，而不是只保留最后一个。\\\\n\\\\nASGI 的固定规范说明：`http.response.start` 不要求立即刷新，服务器可以等到第一次 Response Body 再发送响应头；成功处理 `http.response.body` 的 send 返回时，数据已经交给服务器发送缓冲，但这不确认远端客户端已经消费。断开通知与发送失败还可能存在时间上的竞争。因此至少有三个边界：服务端准备发送、服务器发送缓冲接受、客户端收到并解析。用户 TTFT 应绑定任务定义的首个有效内容；若只测服务端发送函数返回，就不能声称测到了用户体验。\\\\n\\\\n一次内容映射合法，需要满足以下条件。\\\\n\\\\n1. 逻辑输出 token 数 `N` 有明确身份：固定模型、tokenizer、模板、特殊 token 规则和输出过滤条件。不同 tokenizer 或不同模板产生的计数不能直接混用。\\\\n2. 内容 chunk 的累计 token 范围从 0 开始连续、不重叠、不遗漏；重复 chunk、倒退范围或缺失中间内容应被拒绝或标为不完整。\\\\n3. chunk 时间随序号非递减；协议结束时间不早于最后内容时间。跨时间域时不直接要求两个读数满足该不等式，而使用已证明的因果关系或偏移区间。\\\\n4. 若提供逐 token 时间，其数量必须等于 token 数，且时间非递减。若没有逐 token 时间，`N>1` 的多 token chunk 只能提供 chunk 级时间，不得伪造精确 TPOT。\\\\n5. `N=0` 时 TTFT 未定义，但请求仍可以有完成、拒绝、空结果或错误状态；空输出是否算成功由任务定义，不能自动计为一次有效生成。`N=1` 时 TTFT 和请求延迟可定义，TPOT 未定义。\\\\n6. 取消、超时和断开后，已经交付的内容可以计算部分 TTFT 或部分间隔，但没有完整请求完成指标。迟到结果必须携带原尝试代次；不能写入新请求的槽位。\\\\n\\\\n若客户端只能从 chunk 观察内容，需把 chunk 作为观测单位，并额外记录 `m_k`、累计 token 范围和内容身份。这样可以恢复首内容时间、输出 token 总量和 chunk 级间隔，但不能单独恢复 chunk 内每个 token 的精确时间。\\\\n\\\\n## 指标计算算法与状态推进\\\\n\\\\n下面的算法把事件校验、尝试过滤、chunk 合并和指标定义连成一条可复现路径。输入是同一逻辑请求的候选事件和策略；输出是记录、未定义原因和可用于聚合的间隔。\\\\n\\\\n```pseudocode\\\\n算法 BuildRequestMetrics(events, r, policy)\\\\n输入：请求 r 的候选事件；policy 指定时间域、内容事件类型、尝试选择与是否要求精确 token 时间\\\\n输出：REQUEST_RECORD；或拒绝原因\\\\n\\\\n检查 r、时间单位和 policy；建立 seen_event_ids\\\\n选择本次尝试 g；属于其他 g 的事件只保留在诊断集合，不进入 r 的状态\\\\n初始化 status=RECEIVED、send=空、first_content=空、last_content=空、chunks=空\\\\nfor 每个同 g 且未重复的事件 e，按时间和稳定事件优先级处理：\\\\n    若 e 的时间为负或不可比较：拒绝\\\\n    按 e.type 推进状态：\\\\n        SEND：只允许一次；记录 t0；状态仍为 RECEIVED\\\\n        ADMIT：只允许在首次内容前；记录准入结果\\\\n        START：只允许在 ADMIT 后；记录 tX\\\\n        MODEL_TOKEN：只记录模型侧时间，不作为用户内容\\\\n        CONTENT：要求 status 未终止；要求 token_count 为正整数\\\\n                 要求 token_start 等于已收 token 数，或可按 chunk 顺序恢复连续范围\\\\n                 记录 chunk 时间、token 数、可选逐 token 时间；更新 last_content\\\\n                 若这是首个有效内容，记录 first_content；状态转为 STREAMING\\\\n        FINAL：只允许一次；要求不早于最后内容；记录 tF；状态转为 COMPLETED\\\\n        CANCEL/TIMEOUT/ERROR：只允许在 FINAL 前进入对应终止状态；记录原因\\\\n        其他空角色、心跳、usage：不改写内容状态\\\\n    若事件导致已终止状态出现新内容或第二个 FINAL：拒绝或标为身份冲突\\\\n\\\\n校验 chunks：累计 token 连续、时间非递减；若存在逐 token 时间，数量匹配且非递减\\\\nN=已收 token 总数\\\\nif N=0：TTFT=未定义；reason=no_content\\\\nelif 首个有效内容不存在：TTFT=未定义；reason=no_content_event\\\\nelse：TTFT=first_content-send\\\\n\\\\n若全部 chunk 有逐 token 时间：exact_times=按 chunk 顺序展开\\\\n否则若全部 chunk 的 token 数都是 1：exact_times=各 chunk 时间\\\\n否则：exact_times=不可用；exact_TPOT=未定义；可另报 chunk 级估计\\\\nif N>1 且 exact_times 可用：\\\\n    exact_TPOT=(exact_times[N-1]-exact_times[0])/(N-1)\\\\n    exact_ITL=相邻 exact_times 的差\\\\nelse if N=1：exact_TPOT=未定义；reason=no_token_interval\\\\nelse if exact_times 不可用：exact_TPOT=未定义；reason=chunk_only_multi_token\\\\n\\\\n请求完成延迟=最后一个有效终态时间-send；若没有终态则标为未完成\\\\n返回记录；未定义原因必须随记录保存，不能在聚合时静默当作零\\\\n```\\\\n\\\\n状态推进的关键不是字段齐全，而是拒绝不可能的组合：同一内容范围出现两次、最后内容晚于最终响应、旧尝试事件混入新尝试、`N=1` 却产生 TPOT、只有多 token chunk 却声称精确逐 token 间隔，都应进入诊断而不是产生看似正常的数值。\\\\n\\\\n聚合和窗口账务也不能只取成功样本。下面的参考过程先建立到达队列，再统计完成、拒绝、未完成和联合合格结果；每请求平均与合并间隔分开计算。\\\\n\\\\n```pseudocode\\\\n算法 AggregateAndWindow(records, policy)\\\\n输入：已按请求身份去重的 REQUEST_RECORD；观察到达窗 [W0,W1)；排空截止 T_end；分位数定义\\\\n输出：每请求指标、宏平均、合并间隔、窗口计数、goodput 与未定义覆盖\\\\n\\\\n检查 W0<W1、T_end>=W0；建立 seen_request_ids\\\\ncohort=空\\\\nfor record in records：\\\\n    若 record.id 重复：拒绝\\\\n    若 W0<=record.offered<W1：把 record 加入 cohort\\\\n\\\\noffered=cohort 的数量\\\\nadmitted=cohort 中已准入的数量\\\\nrejected=cohort 中未准入的数量\\\\ncompleted=已准入且终态时间<=T_end 的数量\\\\ngood=已准入、终态时间<=T_end、success 与 quality 同时为真的数量\\\\nincomplete=已准入但无终态或终态晚于 T_end 的数量\\\\n\\\\n对 cohort 中每个 record：\\\\n    若 record.TPOT 可用：加入 macro_values\\\\n    若 record.ITL 是精确 token 间隔：把全部间隔加入 pooled_values\\\\n    若 record.ITL 不可用但存在 chunk 级估计：加入 chunk_values，并保留其不是精确间隔的标记\\\\n\\\\nmacro_mean = macro_values 的算术平均；同时报告可用请求数和总请求数\\\\npooled_mean = pooled_values 的算术平均；同时报告间隔数和是否只覆盖部分请求\\\\n若 pooled_mean 可用：ratio_of_sums 的倒数关系只在同一组精确间隔上有意义；不能把 macro_mean 的倒数当作同一吞吐\\\\nquantile(p, population) 必须声明总体和分位数定义；例如 nearest-rank：排序后取第 ceil(p*m) 个值\\\\nwindow_goodput = good / (T_end-W0)，前提是 T_end>W0；若分母不同则另命名\\\\nwindow_offered_rate = offered / (W1-W0)\\\\nsuccess_over_offered = good / offered，前提是 offered>0\\\\n返回所有计数、覆盖和未定义原因；任何空总体都返回未定义，不返回零\\\\n```\\\\n\\\\n## 聚合、窗口与未完成样本\\\\n\\\\n设第 `r` 个请求有 `N_r` 个输出 token，且精确时间可用，则每请求平均为 `m_r=(t_(r,N_r-1)-t_(r,1))/(N_r-1)`。宏平均给每个可用请求相同权重：`M_macro=(1/R')Σm_r`，其中 `R'` 是有定义的请求数。合并间隔平均则按间隔数加权：`M_pooled=Σ(N_r-1)m_r/Σ(N_r-1)`，它让长输出贡献更多间隔。两者的差异不是测量误差，而是聚合对象不同。\\\\n\\\\n设定三个请求：第一个 2 token、首末间隔 10 ms；第二个 11 token、首末间隔 100 ms；第三个 2 token、首末间隔 30 ms。每请求平均分别是 10、10、30 ms，宏平均约为 16.67 ms；合并 12 个间隔后总间隔时间为 140 ms，合并平均约为 11.67 ms。若只报告一个数，必须说明是每请求等权还是间隔加权。\\\\n\\\\n分位数同样要说明总体。对有序值 `x_(1)..x_(m)`，nearest-rank 的 `p` 分位数可取 `x_(ceil(pm))`；另一种插值定义会给出不同数值。每请求 TPOT 的 p99、所有 token 间隔的全局 p99、每请求 p99 再平均，三者不能互相替代。空总体必须报未定义；`p99` 只由少量尾部样本支持时，还应报告样本量和不确定性。\\\\n\\\\n窗口账务常见两种口径。固定到达窗口 `[W0,W1)` 后继续排空到 `T_end`，分母可写为观察时间或到达窗长度，但必须明确；固定完成窗口只统计在窗口内完成的请求，则早先到达的请求也可能进入分母。两种口径不能共用同一个“每秒”标签。\\\\n\\\\n设定 10 s 到达窗口内发出 100 个请求，10 个被拒绝，90 个获接收，其中 80 个在窗口内完成，72 个同时满足质量与全部时延条件。按该到达窗和联合合格定义，goodput 为 `72/10=7.2` 个合格请求每秒，合格请求占全部发出请求的比例为 72%，占获接收请求的比例为 80%。只保留 80 个完成请求会改变分母；把拒绝和未完成请求删掉会让系统看起来更好，却没有解释 offered workload。\\\\n\\\\n联合 SLO 也要直接统计交集。TTFT 合格率 95% 与 ITL 合格率 95% 不保证同一批请求中有 95% 同时合格；两个边缘比例不能替代联合条件。质量不合格、输出被截短、分辨率降低或音频时长缩短，都可能让延迟和吞吐变好，但任务已经改变。\\\\n\\\\n## 条件化成本\\\\n\\\\n指标系统的成本至少分为六类。\\\\n\\\\n- 计算成本：逐事件校验是 `O(E)`；对无序事件排序是 `O(E log E)`；计算每请求平均是 `O(N)`；对 `M` 个间隔或请求求精确分位数通常要排序，成本 `O(M log M)`。直方图或草图可降低内存和排序成本，但引入分桶误差和合并规则。\\\\n- 访存与驻留成本：保存逐 token 时间需要 `O(N)` 个时间戳和身份；只保存 chunk 需要 `O(C)`。设定 10,000 个请求、每个 100 个 token，若每个精确时间戳用 8 字节原始整数，约 8,000,000 字节，即约 7.63 MiB，尚未计对象头和索引；若每请求平均 20 个 chunk，chunk 时间约 1.6 MB 原始数据。保留原始 trace、输出内容和请求身份还会增加驻留。\\\\n- 通信成本：客户端指标、服务端指标和设备 trace 可能经不同通道汇总；序列化、批量上报和时钟校准都消耗网络或主机时间。跨机报告还需保存偏移界限，不能用一次往返时间的一半替代单向延迟。\\\\n- 准备成本：固定 tokenizer、模板、内容过滤规则、事件 schema、请求身份映射和分位数定义都需要准备；准备版本改变可能改变 token 计数或内容边界。\\\\n- 同步成本：在内容 flush、chunk 发送、trace 采样和窗口关闭处加入同步，会改变队列和重叠。用于诊断的详细采集应与其造成的扰动一起报告；正常运行指标不能把 profiler 的同步开销当成服务成本。\\\\n- 关键路径成本：指标聚合若在响应路径上执行，可能推迟 chunk 发送并恶化 ITL；离线聚合不改变用户路径，但增加保留与读取成本。事件采样降低开销，却可能漏掉尾部事件和取消边界。\\\\n\\\\n这些成本不能只相加成一条时间。事件校验、内容发送和分位数计算可以重叠；共享存储、网络和 CPU 又会互相竞争。报告至少应说明观察到的 `E`、`C`、`N`、保留窗口和聚合方法，使读者能判断成本模型是否适用于当前负载。\\\\n\\\\n## 条件变化后的保留、调整与放弃\\\\n\\\\n| 条件变化 | 应保留 | 应调整 | 应考虑放弃 |\\\\n|---|---|---|---|\\\\n| chunk 变大或服务端合并多个 token | 首个有效内容和协议完成事件的定义 | 把精确 ITL 改为 token 级采集；否则明确报 chunk 级估计 | 单 chunk 多 token 时放弃精确 TPOT，不能报零 |\\\\n| 输出长度分布改变 | 每请求与合并间隔两种口径 | 报告输出长度、间隔数和分母 | 不能把宏平均与合并平均互换后继续与旧结果比较 |\\\\n| 代理或客户端缓冲增加 | 服务端发送、缓冲接受、客户端收到三个边界 | 客户端 TTFT 与内部首 token 延迟并列报告 | 不能把服务端 send 返回当作用户收到时间 |\\\\n| 跨机器或跨设备时钟 | 事件身份和因果边 | 保存偏移界限、漂移和校准时间 | 不能从宽区间中挑一个点估计声称毫秒级改进 |\\\\n| 大量单 token 响应 | TTFT、请求延迟和完成率 | 报告 TPOT 可用覆盖率；必要时改用每请求完成时间 | 不能把 `N=1` 的零分母写成零 TPOT |\\\\n| 取消、重试和迟到结果 | 尝试代次、最后已交付内容、终止原因 | 逻辑请求与每尝试指标分开 | 不能把旧尝试内容写入新请求或删掉失败尝试 |\\\\n| 会话、工具和多模态任务 | 任务要求的最终产物和联合质量 | 请求级指标只作为阶段指标 | 不能把中间调用成功当作整个任务完成 |\\\\n\\\\n条件变化后是否需要重新设计，取决于指标回答的问题是否仍相同。若只是输出长度变长，TTFT 的定义仍可保留，但聚合权重改变；若首个内容事件从 token 变成音频包，原来的 TPOT 已经不再是合适的用户指标，应改成首可播放样本、连续供给和音频时长。\\\\n\\\\n## 诊断：竞争解释与区分实验\\\\n\\\\n诊断的目标不是给一次观测贴原因，而是找出能让竞争解释给出不同预测的干预。下表给出常见交界。\\\\n\\\\n| 观察与竞争解释 | 区分实验 | 预测与反证后的修正 |\\\\n|---|---|---|\\\\n| 服务端首 token 提前，但客户端 TTFT 不变：内部执行加速、协议缓冲、内容过滤或网络延迟 | 同时记录模型首 token、服务端首内容、发送缓冲接受和客户端首内容；保持内容与网络条件 | 只有内部事件提前而客户端内容不变，支持协议或过滤解释；若客户端也提前，才支持用户路径改善 |\\\\n| 平均 TPOT 稳定，p99 ITL 变差：chunk 合并、队列抖动或尾部请求 | 固定输出长度和到达过程，对比逐 token 时间与 chunk 级估计；另跑关闭 chunk 合并的合法候选 | 精确 token 间隔不变而 chunk 估计变差，说明聚合或 chunk 边界；精确间隔也变差则查排队和资源竞争 |\\\\n| 吞吐提高但 goodput 降低：完成更多、拒绝更多、输出变短或质量下降 | 固定任务与质量标准，同时报告 offered、admitted、completed、失败和输出长度 | 输出长度或质量改变时，吞吐提升不能直接算作用户收益；若联合合格数仍下降，应回到容量与准入解释 |\\\\n| 每请求 p99 与全局 p99 差异很大：长输出权重、请求间差异或分位数定义 | 保留每个请求的间隔，分别计算宏平均、合并平均和两个总体分位数 | 差异可由输出长度和总体解释时，不应归因为系统抖动；若同一总体仍差异，再查尾部事件 |\\\\n| 单 token 响应出现 TPOT 为零或缺失：分母错误、未定义处理或数据丢失 | 注入 `N=1`、空输出和单 chunk 多 token 的合成轨迹 | 正确实现应把 `N=1` 的 TPOT 标为未定义；若报告零，先修分母和状态语义 |\\\\n| 跨机延迟差异落在时钟界限内：真实变化或时钟偏移 | 保留校准区间，同时比较客户端本地完成和往返观测 | 所有可行偏移都能解释差异时，结论是未区分；只有差异超出界限才支持链路变化 |\\\\n| 旧尝试内容改变 TTFT：正常重试、事件身份错误或迟到回调 | 注入旧代次内容事件，按尝试过滤后重算 | 旧事件被过滤后指标恢复，说明身份或迟到处理错误；若仍变化，再查同一尝试内重复内容 |\\\\n| 首音频包很早但播放卡顿：首包优化、供给中断或客户端缓冲不足 | 记录可播放包到达、累计 sample offset、缓冲欠载区间和播放时钟 | 平均到达率大于 1 仍可能欠载；只有缓冲轨迹能区分首包与连续供给 |\\\\n\\\\n负对照应实际触发错误。例如把均值当 p99、把单 token 的 TPOT 写成零、把一个多 token chunk 的端点差当作精确 TPOT、只按完成请求计算 goodput、把时钟点估计放进空区间，或在旧代次事件混入时仍接受结果。检查必须让这些候选进入同一判据并失败，而不只是让正确实现通过。\\\\n\\\\n## 非文本输出与任务完成边界\\\\n\\\\n文本 token 不是所有任务的完成单位。语音、图像、视频、embedding 和检索需要各自的产物事件。\\\\n\\\\n| 任务 | 可交付结果的事件 | 同时保留的条件 |\\\\n|---|---|---|\\\\n| 多轮会话或工具流程 | 必要依赖完成且最终回答可用 | 中间回合、工具失败、取消、会话级质量和总时延 |\\\\n| Embedding | 全部规定向量已返回且可供消费 | 输入条数、维度、归一化、数值误差和检索质量 |\\\\n| 检索与 reranking | 满足过滤规则的排序结果可用 | top-k、候选集、索引版本、recall 或排序质量 |\\\\n| 图像生成或识别 | 完整图像或规定预测结果可用 | 分辨率、预处理、生成步数、内容和质量条件 |\\\\n| 语音识别 | 首个稳定文本与最终转录分别可用 | 音频窗口、修订规则、词错误率和延迟目标 |\\\\n| 语音或视频生成 | 首个可播放包、连续可消费包及完整输出 | 播放时长、供给间隙、sample offset、帧顺序和联合质量 |\\\\n\\\\n对语音，不能把服务器生成的 codec token 数直接当作播放时长。设客户端缓冲中尚未播放的音频时长为 `B(t)`，可播放音频到达速率为 `a(t)`，正常播放消耗速率为 1，则 `dB/dt = a(t) - 1`。平均 `a>1` 不排除瞬时断供；`B` 太小容易欠载，太大增加首音延迟和取消后的尾音。一个设定例子：24 kHz、单声道、16-bit PCM 的 200 ms 块有 4800 个样本、9600 字节；400 ms 缓冲含 19200 字节。编码压缩可以降低字节数，却不取消这些字节代表的播放时间。\\\\n\\\\n对视频，完成事件应绑定可解码帧或完整片段，并保留时间戳顺序、分辨率和帧数；帧数增加不等于用户看到的时间增加。对 embedding，批量请求的输出条数和维度必须完整；对检索，top-k 和索引版本必须与结果一起保存。生成 tokens/s 不能替代这些任务的完成率或质量。\\\\n\\\\n## 检查与证据范围\\\\n\\\\n随章检查文件为 `tools/check_k_work_001_full.py`。它使用 Python 标准库和有理数参考，检查 nearest-rank 分位数、精确 TPOT、`N=1` 未定义、单 chunk 多 token 的不可分辨性、宏平均与合并间隔的差异、窗口 goodput 的分母、跨时钟区间、尝试过滤以及音频块字节和缓冲欠载。它还构造被同一判据拒绝的负对照：均值冒充 p99、单 token 报 TPOT=0、chunk-only 多 token 报精确 TPOT、仅按完成请求算 goodput、点估计落在时钟界限外、旧尝试事件混入、用 token 数冒充音频字节。\\\\n\\\\n这些检查是 CPU 上的确定性模型，不是 GPU 执行、网络传输、真实服务延迟、时钟校准、音频播放或 Agent 使用效果实测。它们不证明某个推理引擎的采集覆盖、设备可见性或生产尾延迟；真实结论仍需固定版本、输入、到达过程、事件边界和不确定性的设备或服务实验。\\\\n\\\\n<!-- infraagents:provenance -->\\\\n\\\\n## 来源与推导\\\\n\\\\n- [S-GENAI-PERF：NVIDIA GenAI-Perf](../sources/S-GENAI-PERF.md)：固定 README 的 Metrics 表把 TTFT 定义为请求发出到首个响应收到，把 ITL 定义为中间响应之间的时间除以后一响应生成的 token 数，把每用户输出 token 吞吐定义为除首 token 外的输出量除以生成阶段持续时间，并以请求发出到最终响应定义请求延迟。另有说明 token 计数可能不精确，客户端 chunk 与模型 token 并非必然一一对应，测量窗口统计窗口内完成的请求。goodput 文档把 goodput 定义为满足指标约束的完成请求率。本章据此区分首个响应、首个有效内容、chunk 间隔与精确 token 间隔，并把额外质量门限和窗口分母作为任务定义，不把同名指标自动视为同一事件过滤。\\\\n 表示后续内容。本章据此把服务端准备、发送缓冲接受、客户端收到和业务完成分开，推导首内容、背压、取消和迟到结果各自的指标边界。\\\\n  [完整原文](../../references/S-ASGI/reader.html) ·
